Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am. | [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=ebd27beef5864753ba7383b06d021797&_e=GK2DOdtJFMzI5Ey_KYmvf0lwZlf3oiqhtFICaT9I8NMok0vVr83RBpl_NDhJYgfLBYCJZnAThD6khO8nCJlcMutte7pfwAbEfRUIhVYOdZLswrrXZt0Q42JhDhCa87acnPICUaZlCf7WM3sDVtCpnkQRZ2ZSiDbTV1HgJl2oY54tl9bhJgTJwbBUVFN4kGaP_7SRg6g2rBU4lCxgVEQpAfTpQmwd0qXyQbq7kZow-eV9TAc1A_nafMpaVSmtNGY4Tzir9oUaif3YY3sBJvTIao4Rl14XmTA30VRyRG6qhU0_YlS30Nj60Jkxtf2BIKLKAWNOj78yypDXDnk62sA7gBF9N0OL8D8r9P96CSkhjjTTU6lIUsFwknjkMajvS63lLXPTTS9JODM9bi4BUlP09R7qimm6P04vG1Ftr33dt8A%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=ebd27beef5864753ba7383b06d021797&_e=GK2DOdtJFMzI5Ey_KYmvf0lwZlf3oiqhtFICaT9I8NMok0vVr83RBpl_NDhJYgfLBYCJZnAThD6khO8nCJlcMutte7pfwAbEfRUIhVYOdZLswrrXZt0Q42JhDhCa87acnPICUaZlCf7WM3sDVtCpnkQRZ2ZSiDbTV1HgJl2oY54tl9bhJgTJwbBUVFN4kGaP_7SRg6g2rBU4lCxgVEQpAfTpQmwd0qXyQbq7kZow-eV9TAc1A_nafMpaVSmtNGY4Tzir9oUaif3YY3sBJvTIao47S9j8PPrBCLHkxNMEfURS8TkSvWbFMYjU915jhkW_0Mjqk7_m4AO8dUcEhif-pcm3b3vQ4ZK2Edr7Rn6AYg5EXN1w6V3Vg-3inVhaHyNs1pkUlaB9A_Yc5oqLdUnfrz0PghSVM_nmC6WDpN6PD8s%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

3. Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. [**link to donate**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=ebd27beef5864753ba7383b06d021797&_e=GK2DOdtJFMzI5Ey_KYmvf0lwZlf3oiqhtFICaT9I8NMok0vVr83RBpl_NDhJYgfLBYCJZnAThD6khO8nCJlcMutte7pfwAbEfRUIhVYOdZLswrrXZt0Q42JhDhCa87acnPICUaZlCf7WM3sDVtCpnkQRZ2ZSiDbTV1HgJl2oY54tl9bhJgTJwbBUVFN4kGaP_7SRg6g2rBU4lCxgVEQpAfTpQmwd0qXyQbq7kZow-eV9TAc1A_nafMpaVSmtNGY4Tzir9oUaif3YY3sBJvTIarGvqUumLJDPe4sxm_pRrH_nUK5Tt3inS_YUEuzghDZBk-UsXfZTw4RvG6qvsTJ-z9gptFBgWdXUbUKrJM99NCmdEvYDC_CmtxFT34PozgkABJhq3qudrzeRaE_vVmNaR805SYwvwgJR4paD2FGRJxE%3D)

4. Since Tester announced his plans to run for reelection in early 2023, **he’s raised more than $31 million. He raised $7.25 million from January 1st to March 30th.**

My opponent writes that he’s “**stressed** ” and “**worried,** ” but I should be the one in this race who’s stressed and worried. We’re tied with my opponent in the poll, but he’s leaving me in the dust when it comes to fundraising.

I need help. I know you’re receiving many requests for help – I got 70 emails asking for money yesterday. I also know that resources are limited, but **I don’t know where else to turn.**

Last month alone, Jon Tester received donations from 61,000 Democrats. **[Surely, they’re 61,000 conservatives interested in helping me put him out to pasture, right?](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=ebd27beef5864753ba7383b06d021797&_e=GK2DOdtJFMzI5Ey_KYmvf0lwZlf3oiqhtFICaT9I8NMok0vVr83RBpl_NDhJYgfLBYCJZnAThD6khO8nCJlcMutte7pfwAbEfRUIhVYOdZLswrrXZt0Q42JhDhCa87acnPICUaZlCf7WM3sDVtCpnkQRZ2ZSiDbTV1HgJl2oY54tl9bhJgTJwbBUVFN4kGaP_7SRg6g2rBU4lCxgVEQpAfTpQmwd0qXyQbq7kZow-eV9TAc1A_nafMpaVSmtNGY4Tzir9oUaif3YY3sBJvTIav99GzdtNbuGk_6mdYRcSwQo3KNqyCDnuwTZeM73uSPfLK_0IFXRzGeEqRFf1ZXioAAZrwDsOG4HVF0TXmRasIB__2zKfagzDO0ivkjwGQisVPm4TyHjtpN_pcM-cFvG5WF-JgHu5HcmLf4Oy6KsLeY%3D)**
**
I hope you’ll act on this request for help when you see this email.**

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy
Former Navy SEAL
Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate

|
* * *

"
"I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL."

Last email from me tonight, Peter. Thanks for opening it.
Listen, when I was first thinking about running for Arizona’s Senate seat last year I really didn’t know what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters and friends who I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew was that I was going to need the support of a huge team behind me. We’ve built that team up now, and I’m proud you’re a part of it.
Over the last few months I’ve learned just how important this team really is. Your voice and your support have had a huge impact.
But beyond us, no one is coming to save the day. We don’t have an army of millionaires and billionaires airdropping pallets of cash on us, and I wouldn’t want to do it that way even if it was an option.

body:

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this BREAKING NEWS from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20b71b87f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .
Florida-based Chicago Radio Host Dan Proft Calls Trump a “Tyrant” and “Dictator” in Bizarre Podcast Rant (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/florida-based-chicago-radio-host-dan-proft-calls-trump-a-tyrant-and-dictator-in-bizarre-podcast-rant.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20b71b87f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/florida-based-chicago-radio-host-dan-proft-calls-trump-a-tyrant-and-dictator-in-bizarre-podcast-rant.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20b71b87f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Conservative political operative Dan Proft testifies in a hearing Monday focused on allegations that he illegally coordinated campaign expenses with Darren Bailey’s 2022 run for governor. (Capitol News Illinois photo by Andrew Adams)

By Illinois Review

In late April, Naples-based Chicago radio host Dan Proft, in an episode on his podcast, Dan Proft Counterculture (https://amgreatness.com/2024/04/22/dan-proft-commentary-trump-the-tyrant-refuses-to-dictate-on-abortion/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20b71b87f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , launched into a bizarre rant on abortion and referred to President Donald Trump as a “tyrant” and a “dictator.”

“Trump is the strangest of all iterations of tyrants: one who believes in federalism as he acknowledged when he invoked the Bill of Rights (the 10th Amendment specifically) in response to criticisms from some pro-lifers,” said Proft.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nNZKKyYB_DM&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20b71b87f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Dan Proft delivers a bizarre rant on abortion and referred to President Trump as a "tyrant" and "dictator" (Click to play video).

On Monday, Proft appeared before an Illinois State Board of Elections hearing officer, as lawyers discussed whether or not his PAC – People Who Play By The Rules, was illegally coordinating with Darren Bailey’s campaign when he was running for Illinois governor in 2022. As Crain’s Chicago Business (https://www.chicagobusiness.com/politics/proft-super-pac-comes-under-fire-attorneys?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=20b71b87f5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) reported, Profit appeared at the hearing 15 minutes late, agitated – “plopping” his golf hat on the table.

Bailey campaign officials, including Bailey – are not friends with Proft, or even acquaintances – far from it – but the campaign was in need of money from billionaire donor Richard Uihlein who was funding Proft’s PAC. Uihlein had indicated that he was not going to pour money directly into Bailey’s campaign – instead, he was going to give the money to Proft, whom he trusted. PAC’s must remain independent and they cannot coordinate with campaigns that they are supporting financially.

Florida-based Chicago Radio Host Dan Proft Calls Trump a “Tyrant” and “Dictator” in Bizarre Podcast Rant () Conservative political operative Dan Proft testifies in a hearing Monday focused on allegations that he illegally coordinated campaign expenses with Darren Bailey’s 2022 run for governor. (Capitol News Illinois photo by Andrew Adams) By Illinois Review In late April, Naples-based Chicago radio host Dan Proft, in an episode on his podcast, Dan Proft Counterculture () , launched into a bizarre rant on abortion and referred to President Donald Trump as a “tyrant” and a “dictator.” “Trump is the strangest of all iterations of tyrants: one who believes in federalism as he acknowledged when he invoked the Bill of Rights (the 10th Amendment specifically) in response to criticisms from some pro-lifers,” said Proft. Dan Proft delivers a bizarre rant on abortion and referred to President Trump as a "tyrant" and "dictator" (Click to play video). On Monday, Proft appeared before an Illinois State Board of Elections hearing officer, as lawyers discussed whether or not his PAC – People Who Play By The Rules, was illegally coordinating with Darren Bailey’s campaign when he was running for Illinois governor in 2022. As Crain’s Chicago Business () reported, Profit appeared at the hearing 15 minutes late, agitated – “plopping” his golf hat on the table. Bailey campaign officials, including Bailey – are not friends with Proft, or even acquaintances – far from it – but the campaign was in need of money from billionaire donor Richard Uihlein who was funding Proft’s PAC. Uihlein had indicated that he was not going to pour money directly into Bailey’s campaign – instead, he was going to give the money to Proft, whom he trusted. PAC’s must remain independent and they cannot coordinate with campaigns that they are supporting financially. But as it was revealed () on Monday, just one day after Bailey’s primary election victory, Proft requested to meet with Bailey and his campaign manager in a backroom of a Chicago Country Club where he slid over an envelope that he said contained $20 million. And like a scene out of a movie, Proft said Bailey could deposit the check if Bailey would hand control of the campaign over to him. A quid pro quo. name: Scott Baugh
subject: April Wrap-Up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Baugh for Congress
body:
|
---
| | [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=b753b261e7&e=8a657725d1)
---
| Peter,

April has been an incredible and fun month for our team! It has been a privilege to meet so many of you across our beautiful district and we are excited to let the good times roll! If we haven’t had the pleasure yet, we have great opportunities coming up in May and we want to hear from you! Together we can protect this special place we call home and build a stronger future for our children and our community.
---
| |
---
**I had a colorful morning at the Great Park. I couldn't think of a better way to celebrate Holi, and the good times ahead in the spring and summer months. What an amazing and *Bright* way to celebrate the triumph of good over evil.**
|
---
We had a great evening in my home city of Huntington Beach, talking to neighbors about the future. Together, Huntington Beach can continue to be a strong community. The future is bright for CA-47!
|
---
**Thank you to everyone who came to our meet and greet in Seal Beach. What an incredible night! A special thank you to our host and our incredible band. Let’s keep it rocking all the way to November!**
|
---
**We had an amazing time across the district at the Kiwanis Easter Egg Hunt in Huntington Beach and the Seal Beach Classic Car Show. Community is what drives us forward!**
|
---
It was an honor to welcome Speaker Mike Johnson to Newport Beach this month! His support and desire to help us to win in Orange County is truly appreciated. Together, we are building a stronger future for our community and country.
|
---
**Thank you to the Honorable John Lewis and everyone who came out to Newport for great conversations. I always welcome the chance to talk to neighbors and discuss the important issues that our country faces, and why we need new leadership in Washington. We are grateful for the support!**
|
---
**I had a wonderful time at the We Are Costa Mesa Business Roundtable, where I met with business and community leaders from across Costa Mesa.

Costa Mesa is a city with many challenges but a lot of hope. Together with our business community, our local electeds, and others, we can bring Costa Mesa back to the vibrant, prosperous community it should be.**
|
---
** I had the privilege of speaking at the 2024 Nature Conservation Heroes Conference this month!

This incredible event brought together experts worldwide to discuss critical issues like pollution and biodiversity loss. I shared my vision for a collaborative platform to raise awareness and drive action on these global crises. Thank you to our hosts, and Mr. Chris Ho for your stunning paintings.

In our district, we're blessed with breathtaking coastal beauty and vibrant natural landscapes. Protecting our land is essential for preserving the unique character of Orange County and ensuring its continued enjoyment for future generations.**
|
---
**It was great to see Former NFL football player and now Congressman Burgess Owens who stopped by CA47! I may not be a Super Bowl Champion, but in Congress, I will be a champion of the people. Just like Owens!**
|
---
**We had a fun and productive evening at our young professionals event. It was great meeting so many new people who care about our community and our future. Together we will deliver results.**

Fellow Conservative,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=44f55d598b1f4ddfad1b7d7d3c117b9e&_e=LqeW45FHTe37WnckBk_Cxv5z_xkDp22tJNvURCCsbRg-NfKune_SwbvKpJXVc-uhzzcZ1IRw1ret34pltcwRX-O7mjPSZWd_KjAe-5AIOK707LRqovnta53CJ-VA6BWAIxs9MpZo_oqZ8KU9DdQjK16-hmNpG72Mjh1Bu3EJRNnNXx2wRGH41wSmKvNbOAYqw52KORmF3nK6WCqwqtIElG_o8c76Sq6z3MiXlxWtGE8ijfKiV7-T8Y3p3eoxyyd3zRQHWFGT0yctrFxv1u2afMCIA1T8GLwE2wAFFZMRZ_WIXp1tI9mw4iz6trCCdS3hO47IFt3J6IzJQXBXRqUVMQeKinWiYX0bDk26tt2R3-JZiHkiMRDaFsdDuJ9B_MZQF0UGjvlfRsIRsv-amouq47FoxthLSEsu-1hKRm8nWpc%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

3. Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. [**link to donate**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=44f55d598b1f4ddfad1b7d7d3c117b9e&_e=LqeW45FHTe37WnckBk_Cxv5z_xkDp22tJNvURCCsbRg-NfKune_SwbvKpJXVc-uhzzcZ1IRw1ret34pltcwRX-O7mjPSZWd_KjAe-5AIOK707LRqovnta53CJ-VA6BWAIxs9MpZo_oqZ8KU9DdQjK16-hmNpG72Mjh1Bu3EJRNnNXx2wRGH41wSmKvNbOAYqw52KORmF3nK6WCqwqtIElG_o8c76Sq6z3MiXlxWtGE8ijfKiV7-T8Y3p3eoxyyd3zRQHWFGT0yctrFxv1u2afJoZQk7mT97TwmpodpxGjtyXYjFHjuoALycD4roQD690c1tsumuaos-H26YuV8aGeaBABJOpIghIv-uo2AM72uH--P4u_BlZA0aK-Rb1CRFx_RQxZmv8DuCyVuFZi8eZnnVRnc_fD6hBuaUvi3JFfJc%3D)

4. Since Tester announced his plans to run for reelection in early 2023, **he’s raised more than $31 million. He raised $7.25 million from January 1st to March 30th.**

My opponent writes that he’s “**stressed** ” and “**worried,** ” but I should be the one in this race who’s stressed and worried. We’re tied with my opponent in the poll, but he’s leaving me in the dust when it comes to fundraising.

I need help. I know you’re receiving many requests for help – I got 70 emails asking for money yesterday. I also know that resources are limited, but **I don’t know where else to turn.**

Last month alone, Jon Tester received donations from 61,000 Democrats. **[Surely, they’re 61,000 conservatives interested in helping me put him out to pasture, right?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=44f55d598b1f4ddfad1b7d7d3c117b9e&_e=LqeW45FHTe37WnckBk_Cxv5z_xkDp22tJNvURCCsbRg-NfKune_SwbvKpJXVc-uhzzcZ1IRw1ret34pltcwRX-O7mjPSZWd_KjAe-5AIOK707LRqovnta53CJ-VA6BWAIxs9MpZo_oqZ8KU9DdQjK16-hmNpG72Mjh1Bu3EJRNnNXx2wRGH41wSmKvNbOAYqw52KORmF3nK6WCqwqtIElG_o8c76Sq6z3MiXlxWtGE8ijfKiV7-T8Y3p3eoxyyd3zRQHWFGT0yctrFxv1u2afHJ3HmaZDz69uDVoRTDlb5LFzcY9LjS-9yt5IQbxCdW8EwsnAOsDQzdOWz-waHm84u_8tpaL4otGpIgz-fyS1SQDyIpqT0F-8SyTXDHFcPEOoTTTbqS1eJ1dXD-fss_MpP2e9FmNLM59handaVgINGg%3D)**
**
I hope you’ll act on this request for help when you see this email.**

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy
Former Navy SEAL
Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate

|

"I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. Fellow Conservative,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=9aa84a5db6b346eda54a9de8ca79e39c&_e=tV4_ZJWGyRGqbInHyt9HIgcu7ZpVsO4hrOIErbtRxBPm4v1HHbJzssKTkfbExTmJTx7bSE0Yi-pLl0NDIG6HTuyaboST1Z-whvJYgv9liV7IJEdOhnN7Ho21pC22H2elS-lwdGfgbYv6xreSy9yDMygEhnuaLapJUQ3fxQr5VnRNUVkQkY2Bg7bIMXpisIYXt-DUcd6eGpzjnVUMH6UAgY-HkKJ_xKg2PTEovbFQWMiC4tm0Oii4wWyN2fXXVbfTf52Q0ghRideDghW9axyGRkNI2535wVRNnhMwp1izIkfjrN6OvdCflrCPtJXdTM1advxip1bh5JylDKBqezU7yM6NCcwj180RXXFs3JyS88uxqjN0zLUhXuN_v_XG_M2wC4zrgYi6smZ0YIzaMLkcTPjlXJWw0ght90_-_pdJnmY%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

3. Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. [**link to donate**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=9aa84a5db6b346eda54a9de8ca79e39c&_e=tV4_ZJWGyRGqbInHyt9HIgcu7ZpVsO4hrOIErbtRxBPm4v1HHbJzssKTkfbExTmJTx7bSE0Yi-pLl0NDIG6HTuyaboST1Z-whvJYgv9liV7IJEdOhnN7Ho21pC22H2elS-lwdGfgbYv6xreSy9yDMygEhnuaLapJUQ3fxQr5VnRNUVkQkY2Bg7bIMXpisIYXt-DUcd6eGpzjnVUMH6UAgY-HkKJ_xKg2PTEovbFQWMiC4tm0Oii4wWyN2fXXVbfTf52Q0ghRideDghW9axyGRpzB1wjFw5ZCUyLbzNVH8N4kgQmSkkCEJMcYEMMEte6KCSEwS4Nwa8VtmFq6bIr_7LEby46Y6ifW8mXWduVEG8uifedRE8_GBbAZycTmWbHg7JpHrnxQPnnA2t-CL9rVnmdnyfUoAbjj-CybLxPeut0%3D)

4. Since Tester announced his plans to run for reelection in early 2023, **he’s raised more than $31 million. He raised $7.25 million from January 1st to March 30th.**

My opponent writes that he’s “**stressed** ” and “**worried,** ” but I should be the one in this race who’s stressed and worried. We’re tied with my opponent in the poll, but he’s leaving me in the dust when it comes to fundraising.

I need help. I know you’re receiving many requests for help – I got 70 emails asking for money yesterday. I also know that resources are limited, but **I don’t know where else to turn.**

Last month alone, Jon Tester received donations from 61,000 Democrats. **[Surely, they’re 61,000 conservatives interested in helping me put him out to pasture, right?](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=9aa84a5db6b346eda54a9de8ca79e39c&_e=tV4_ZJWGyRGqbInHyt9HIgcu7ZpVsO4hrOIErbtRxBPm4v1HHbJzssKTkfbExTmJTx7bSE0Yi-pLl0NDIG6HTuyaboST1Z-whvJYgv9liV7IJEdOhnN7Ho21pC22H2elS-lwdGfgbYv6xreSy9yDMygEhnuaLapJUQ3fxQr5VnRNUVkQkY2Bg7bIMXpisIYXt-DUcd6eGpzjnVUMH6UAgY-HkKJ_xKg2PTEovbFQWMiC4tm0Oii4wWyN2fXXVbfTf52Q0ghRideDghW9axyGRqk77dORGkSCyltL7dNxsybnp5i70liR8wRGjKl3daOk3c3W22A9krnwXScN9wA4vELxxpp6YUsjsvPWYQ_CRqSBt2bvuPCn3HaElt83gwbXiO5lJqgoC0wpzI_XoojqgzSplJ4Wmq8Ilk0X45uqw4Y%3D)**
**
I hope you’ll act on this request for help when you see this email.**

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: fwd - big news!
body:
Hey Pro-Life Friend,

I know I emailed you yesterday about this privately, but below is the email I'm sending to our entire supporter list today.

We're already at $35,000 toward our **$200,000 Matching Challenge** . . . but still have a ways to go!

So, if you didn't get a chance to chip in last night, please give today by clicking on one of my links in the forwarded message below!

\- Kristan

_\---------- begin forwarded message ----------_

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

With everything on the line in 2024, this news from two of our most generous supporters – one from Texas and one from Florida – was a Godsend.

They just informed me that they are willing to match every dollar _Students for Life Action_ raises by this Thursday up to $200,000 in support of our 2024 election year plans.

**Pro-Life Friend, with staff and student canvassers set to deploy across 10 key states in the next few weeks, this news couldn’t have come at a better time!**

Even as I write you, finishing up our first crisscross campaign in Florida, urging people to vote no on the state’s pro-abortion referendum!

**[So, could you please give generously right away to take advantage of this $200,000 Matching Challenge IMMEDIATELY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-y/)?**

**[>> If you could give $250, it would be worth $500](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-j/)!**
**[>> If you could give $100, it would be worth $200](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-i/)!**
**[>> If you could give $50, it would be worth $100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-d/)!**
**[>> If you could give $25, it would be worth $50](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-h/)!**
I know you understand just how high the stakes are this election year.

As _The Washington Post_ reported recently, President Joe Biden’s re-election campaign “plans to spend every day until November 5th” talking about abortion.

And if the President manages to stumble to re-election – and the Abortion Lobby seizes control of the U.S. House and expands their U.S. Senate majority – there could be no stopping their radical agenda, including:

***** _PACKING THE U.S. SUPREME COURT_** with as many as five new Justices who will serve as rubber stamps for Planned Parenthood’s radical and bloody agenda. The constant attacks on Justice Clarence Thomas we’ve seen over the past year were designed to grease the skids for this;
***** _DESTROYING THE U.S. SENATE FILIBUSTER_ ,** which is a Senate rule that effectively requires all major legislation to gain 60 Senate votes for passage. Pro-abortion Democrats are currently only two votes away from gutting the filibuster, which will allow them to pass any pro-abortion law they want and change America forever; and
***** _RAMMING PRO-ABORTION LEGISLATION FAR WORSE THAN _ROE V. WADE_ INTO LAW_.** President Biden is on record supporting the so-called _“Women’s Health Protection Act.”_ The Abortion Lobby’s goal is to pass this federal legislation forcing all 50 states to allow abortion-on-demand up until _(and even up to a week after)_ birth – and force taxpayers to fund it all!
We have no choice but to fight like never before.

The good news is, polls say President Biden is continuing to stumble with young voters.

While polling has been untrustworthy at best for years now, media elites are starting to freak out, issuing a constant flood of headlines like:

**>>>** “Biden, a Pre-Boomer, is Losing the Young Voters Democrats Need” (CNN);
**>>>** “Trump Gets Surprise Boost With Young Voters Amid Biden Disillusionment” _(The Hill);_ and
**>>>** “Democrats Have a Problem With Young Voters. They Hope the Battle Over Abortion Will Solve It. Will That Work?” _(Los Angeles Times)._
All of this is no accident.

With your support, we’ve conducted one of the largest youth outreach efforts in American history over the past year.

We’ve visited 947 college campuses across the country, trained 28,252 activists, started 163 new campus chapters _(bringing our total to 1,447),_ and garnered over 231,400,000 views of our online videos.

**With our years of experience of talking about abortion with young voters, no one is better at talking to young people about abortion than we are!**

**[But we have so much more work to do – work we can only accomplish if you’ll help us fully satisfy this $200,000 Matching Challenge](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-k/).**

**[With your generous support](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-u/),** _Students for Life Action_ is planning to pull out all the stops this election year, targeting all the following states.

Please note the stars denote states referendum battles in addition to Presidential/Legislative Targets.

**_TIER 1 TARGETS_ :**

Arizona*
Georgia
Pennsylvania
Nevada*
Michigan
Wisconsin

**_TIER 2 TARGETS_ :**

Florida*
Maine
Montana*
North Carolina

**In addition, we’re also targeting Arkansas, Missouri, Nebraska, and South Dakota as they’re all slated to have late-term abortion referendums.**

So, with your help, _Students for Life Action_ is planning on pulling out all the stops with:

**• _GRASSROOTS TRAININGS_ :**
Before a young activist can start making an impact, they must be trained. Our top-notch trainings aren’t just designed to train activists how to most effectively knock on doors and make phone calls, however. We want the young people we train to stay in the fight.
Based on past studies, 55% of the young people _SFLAction_ engages are getting involved in politics for the first time and 85% commit to carry on and do more. So, these programs are critical to keeping the Pro-Life Movement growing. If we can raise the resources, we plan to train 2,540 new activists in 2024.
**• _DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING_ :**
Once trained, our students will personally knock on hundreds of thousands of doors across our 14 targeted states in 2024. Our campaign will even collaborate with homeschool groups and church communities to reach new audiences and expand our reach.
Each door we knock on costs less than $3 each. And studies show that nothing makes more of an impact on a voter than a face-to-face conversation. And that impact lasts beyond one election cycle. Voters who are talked to personally in one election are more likely to vote in subsequent elections.
**• _OUR “VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST” DIGITAL CAMPAIGN_ :**
Younger voters especially are immersed in the digital world. If we want to reach them, we have to be where they are.
Our “Vote Pro-Life First” Digital Campaign runs targeted, survey-style ads to young people aged 18-35 who we’ve identified as swing voters with a low likelihood to turn out and vote. We’ve found we can secure a pledge to “Vote Pro-Life First” from these voters for less than $2!
**• _EARLY VOTER AND VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS_ :**
The Left holds a big advantage in early voter turnout, which has to be stopped. Public records enable them to verify once someone has voted, which means they’re immediately able to stop spending money targeting that voter. For us to compete with them, we must do the same.
That’s why _SFLAction_ is prepared to target ideal voter bases likes mega-churches, church conferences, and Christian college campuses to beat the Left to the punch on early voting.
**• _MAIL-IN BALLOT CHASING_ :**
Using daily voter data election boards, _Students for Life Action_ is preparing to reach out to targeted pro-life voters who’ve been mailed blank ballots and follow up with them until we know they’ve voted.
**• _CAMPUS OUTREACH_ :**
Our student leaders will host campus voter rallies and educational displays, recruit volunteers, organize door-to-door canvasing deployments, and even bus pro-life voters to the polls who don’t have a ride.
**• _PHONE BANKS AND TEXTING_ :**
Time-tested methods like peer-to-peer text messaging and phone calls are a must in any effective Get-Out-The-Vote programs.
**• _OUR NEW SOCIAL MEDIA INFLUENCER CAMPAIGN_ :**
_Students for Life Action's_ massive network of students and friends in the pro-life movement gives us a unique ability to reach voters online. With our social media influencer campaign, our plan is to leverage organic content from our student group members to outperform mainstream news outlets and persuade undecided voters.
During the Ohio Issue 1 referendum battle last year, _SFLAction_ was the #1 most “heard” voice on social media on the issue – even beating The New York Times! This is, by far, our most effective way of getting around legacy media mouthpieces.
**• _RELATIONAL TEXTING AND CALLING_ :**
One major way we plan to expand our reach to voters is to simply use the contacts in our student activists’ phones. We’ve found that, on average, every young person has 50-70 contacts in their phones. Some have well over 100. With the creation of an app that allows our young people to personally reach out to their contacts, we’ll be able to reach a massive number of voters on a daily basis with poll-tested messaging – all for very little cost.
**• _ENGAGING AND MOBILIZING _STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION_ “ALUMNI_:”**
Today, _SFLAction_ boasts roughly 200,000 “alumni.” These are adults who used to be members of on-campus chapters, and want to stay involved, but have since graduated.
With the creation of our “Abortion Free Cities” programs, we’ve directed these “alumni” to get to work in their local cities, form partnerships with local pro-lifers and churches, knock on doors, and raise awareness of pregnancy help centers – and even lobby city governments not to allow new abortion facilities to open.
These efforts have built an impressive network of local pro-lifers, who we’ll be engaging in referendum states with “Abortion on the Ballot” activism kits to enable them to drive turnout against pro-abortion referendums.
But Pro-Life Friend, I can’t do any of this without your help.

And I can’t wait around until October to get it started either.

**_If you and I don’t want to live in the nightmare the Abortion Lobby has planned for our country, we have to fight_.**

Or else Planned Parenthood and their puppet politicians will triumph.

And if that happens, there might not be much left of the America we love to pass down to our kids and grandkids.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to give generously in support of this $200,000 Matching Challenge](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-o/).**

**[>> If you give $250, it will be worth $500](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-b/)!**
**[>> If you give $100, it will be worth $200](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-n/)!**
**[>> If you give $50, it will be worth $100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-p/)!**
**[>> If you give $25, it will be worth $50](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-x/)!**
With everything on the line this election year, _we have to fight_!

It’s that simple, Pro-Life Friend.

Let’s give this everything we have.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – Two of our most generous supporters – one from Texas and one from Florida – just agreed to match every dollar _Students for Life Action_ raises by this Thursday up to $200,000 in support of our 2024 election year plans.

**[So, could you please give generously right away to take advantage of this $200,000 Matching Challenge IMMEDIATELY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gltpyd-duchtdja-m/)?**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

| Fellow Conservative,

It’s Jim Jordan with a message about a couple of things I know to be true:
1. We must do everything within our power to hold onto the U.S. House – the future of our country depends on it

body:
Peter,

Our educational institutions are under threat from within, with radical views and endorsements of terrorist organizations becoming alarmingly common.

The United Nations’ “Small Arms Treaty” has been the Gun Control Lobby’s crown jewel for decades.

They’ve been waiting for an anti-gun President, like Joe Biden, to take the White House **so they can launch an all-out effort to ratify it in the U.S. Senate**.

Now, they think they finally see their opportunity to _ram it through_!

But you and I have a chance to stop them cold -- **[as long as we take IMMEDIATE action to help dismantle this dangerous Treaty](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9586r1kjlotvwm2igncrpdurqx3dve014mzm4egwdzfvjhz1n3r32wgtzobuv1smbqyn4qnuuyula81q6qo5ve7q4wjqrkvmj0sinoxs6shp3fo0agexr42rw79n0wxsp4zyf4j4fvv0s84eufygabcxytwpb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scr81x)**.

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Fellow Patriot,
**“BIDEN AIMS TO SIGN ON TO UN'S GLOBAL GUN REGISTRATION TREATY.”**
That was the headline in the _Washington Examiner_ shortly after President Biden’s State Department spokesman told international bureaucrats of “the continuing commitment of the United States” to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” during the gun control Conference of State Parties in Geneva, Switzerland.

Just a few weeks later, President Biden himself spoke before the United Nations in New York City, stating: _“We’ll continue to uphold the long-standing rules and norms... Bedrock commitments,**like support for arms control measures** to reduce the risk and enhance transparency.”_ Fellow Patriot, anyone hoping that President Biden wouldn’t use his bully pulpit to RAM the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” down the throats of Americans just got those hopes CRUSHED.

The battle over implementation of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- the crown jewel in the gun grabbers’ designs for the globe -- is about to reach a fever pitch.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9586r1kjlotvwm2igncrq0i7dlk3vfya0em8kuxkyjs46obzvvezfwspkqf53rt6j8pkncnz2y9bz8p1tvf0jypeio0htyjcdwnkidyieuqgwp8crf3tduq6pk2nvvkhijanwmyit7t7s6rfvlew1cm17dq5y&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scr81x)**!

As you’ll see, this survey insists that your U.S. Senators do everything in their power to oppose the UN “Small Arms Treaty” in the U.S. Senate.

_If there’s anything we’ve learned, it’s that globalists have been telling LIES about the supposed “need’ for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” for years_.

From the beginning, gun grabbers have claimed the purpose of the Treaty is keeping arms out of the hands of terrorists, insurgents, rogue states, and gang members.

But at the very same time the Biden Administration was pledging their support for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty,” they were leaving $83 BILLION in U.S. military weaponry to the Taliban!

They don’t care about keeping guns out of the hands of terrorists.

_They care about keeping guns out of the hands of law-abiding Americans_!

Reading through the details of the UN “Small Arms Treaty,” it’s hard to see how our Second Amendment could survive, if ratified.

For starters, the Treaty text demands the U.S. identify “end users” (gun buyers), document “the quantity, value, and model/type” of firearms and ammunition, and develop “national control standards” to regulate transfers.

_In other words, by design it’s an International Gun Registry that’ll include detailed information on American gun owners just like you -- the first step toward outright CONFISCATION_.

Worse, all that information would be made accessible by despots and foreign governments including the Treaty's largest signer -- Communist China.

**[As you can see, it’s vital you sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators demanding they reject this scheme](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9586r1kjlotvwm2igncrqmm05qervh9mj9j7e8pou72aqfe9e068ww2m9sidzfu3525xv2ndyy0ry8aaeb9insw7a34ovno6y471u6apqvko0j5s6dqq3ibj7aho2vonscb0nsoa4hrqs4cgx5k9qcfsf17jg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scr81x)**!

Introductory language already includes: *** _Mandated national “screening” for those seeking to own guns_ , giving bureaucrats the final say on whether or not you’re “competent” enough to own a firearm; *** _Restrictive licensing for gun and ammo sales_ , and perhaps even bans on anything from semi-auto rifles to shotguns and handguns; *** _Restrictions on the number of guns and amount of ammo any “properly-licensed” individual may legally own_ ; *** _Bans on magazines holding more than ten rounds_ ; and *** _Bans on owning a firearm for self-defense_ \-- unless a citizen can somehow get government approval (which will only happen if you’re “connected” -- or paid half-a-million dollars for one of Hunter Biden’s paintings). Believe me, the United Nations has no intention of slow walking any of this.

To them, your Second Amendment freedoms are a threat to their grand “utopian” designs.

Enemies like Red China are so eager to see every American disarmed, they’re pouring money into the UN “Small Arms Treaty” hand-over-fist.

_So, it’s no wonder why they’re hell-bent on forcing the U.S. to submit to this globalist gun control scam -- and why we must defeat it_!

**[I’m counting on you to help beat the UN by signing your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9586r1kjlotvwm2igncrqvzeufydvihjfdw6xk4cpsb8zmgi0svfnva6wv0q87ulohj8cqni6xd5x90o3gcdbmcyrg7fwlcysa243xbg0xtftt25jbbmsn1a1raoxubd0vbb2y2revpxs31hyo3kddoiqn1b1&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scr81x)**.

As soon the gun grabbers have 67 votes to ratify the Treaty in the U.S. Senate, you can bet Biden’s pal, Sen. Chuck Schumer, will call for the vote.

But we can’t wait until then to fight back because even now, one-world bureaucrats are pushing these gun controls deep into every part of government.

_On top of Biden’s ATF anti-gun executive actions, a headline from _The Hill_ shows how “Democrats’ latest backdoor plan to limit gun ownership” involves new State Department “sanctions” designed to drive the price of ammo by BANNING imports_.

That’s the same State Department which NAGR caught red-handed trying to siphon your tax dollars into funding the UN “Small Arms Treaty.”

_Worse, since day one of the COVID-19 outbreak, our court system has said yes to almost any politician cooking up any unconstitutional idea so long as it’s under the guise of “public health_.”

So now Biden’s Center for Disease Control (CDC) is pushing a new Euro-centric gun control framework that says _“Using a public health approach is essential to addressing firearm violence and keeping people safe and healthy.”_

That’s why insisting that your U.S. Senators OPPOSE the ratification of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” is not enough.

We must insist that the U.S. Senate ensures that NOT ONE TAXPAYER CENT is spent by Biden on implementing any part of this Treaty or what it stands for.

But I’m counting on your help to send that message -- before it’s too late.

**[First, please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9586r1kjlotvwm2igncrqf1wi8t3vkuwc975rzi48cnehdju8ijq2vm2hx40exvhwbahjco0cxthw9nlr07z34j17xnmya52n7j6b0dmyz1mk0khaa06ebpqh6tp4u36wocpfde7s7nes1oizu9a4dinlwhte&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scr81x)**.

Second, please agree to your most generous contribution to help the National Association for Gun Rights mobilize a grassroots firestorm against the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- using everything from _U.S. Mail_ , to _phones_ , to _email_ , _blogs_ , and _guest editorials_ , _hard-hitting video_ and even _paid media_ if we can raise resources.

If at all possible, I’m hoping you’ll agree to $100.

I know that’s a lot to ask for, believe me. But the fight is here, Fellow Patriot. It’s on. There’s no time to wait.

**[But if $100 is just too much -- even given the urgency of the situation -- please agree to $30, or at least $15 TODAY](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=8hhwj26zj0mlmzn51743xf1yi1f93iqbugc0gl8mws4msk5ix0w6f0difo7ovs1to7wy8ecuigr2vh183sj2hs1o6to75uadw6f805nyy5jfrpikhwkqsda69iwf5zbcjpfc8w558kd98o3xitlnfcql0cacmyl0f68mh14jqzodut5them5o6bkm0kddawr4zninj8&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scr81x)**.

Whatever you can do, please act IMMEDIATELY. There’s no time to waste.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President
National Association for Gun Rights**

P.S. Reports say the Biden Administration will be signing on to the UN “Small Arms Treaty” any day, setting up an all-out fight over ratification and implementation here in the United States.

body:

* * *

| | | | | | |

|

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations’ “Small Arms Treaty” has been the Gun Control Lobby’s crown jewel for decades.

They’ve been waiting for an anti-gun President, like Joe Biden, to take the White House **so they can launch an all-out effort to ratify it in the U.S. Senate**.

Now, they think they finally see their opportunity to _ram it through_!

But you and I have a chance to stop them cold -- **[as long as we take IMMEDIATE action to help dismantle this dangerous Treaty](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9yaimj682mil2jqfqapzotuzox82wbshwcqniyz2fso2ajkfewfe6ugqnueru2at89zvu8zbzyvm7rg1t5euogb1kz5iriiuwditxmh6ju4wqndqlbvqi42ykn0brh45do2vd21ekfm4xo2gowjenaibjzcxq&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scrb6i)**.

As Dudley Brown, President of the National Association for Gun Rights, explains in the email below, it’s absolutely critical we act now!

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Fellow Patriot,
**“BIDEN AIMS TO SIGN ON TO UN'S GLOBAL GUN REGISTRATION TREATY.”**
That was the headline in the _Washington Examiner_ shortly after President Biden’s State Department spokesman told international bureaucrats of “the continuing commitment of the United States” to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” during the gun control Conference of State Parties in Geneva, Switzerland.

Just a few weeks later, President Biden himself spoke before the United Nations in New York City, stating: _“We’ll continue to uphold the long-standing rules and norms... Bedrock commitments,**like support for arms control measures** to reduce the risk and enhance transparency.”_ Fellow Patriot, anyone hoping that President Biden wouldn’t use his bully pulpit to RAM the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” down the throats of Americans just got those hopes CRUSHED.

The battle over implementation of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- the crown jewel in the gun grabbers’ designs for the globe -- is about to reach a fever pitch.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9yaimj682mil2jqfqapzocirc02qwd3ut81mcoqsabkyjr1s117ojusmywi22sbps3r6bwzg7ym06s5aen9pcahscq9ptxmkrndw6bizvva1gha4czgn8uqpe1fbkgtxn538u7dwyt8nxmphpd3tabs5ujwpf&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scrb6i)**!

As you’ll see, this survey insists that your U.S. Senators do everything in their power to oppose the UN “Small Arms Treaty” in the U.S. Senate.

_If there’s anything we’ve learned, it’s that globalists have been telling LIES about the supposed “need’ for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” for years_.

From the beginning, gun grabbers have claimed the purpose of the Treaty is keeping arms out of the hands of terrorists, insurgents, rogue states, and gang members.

But at the very same time the Biden Administration was pledging their support for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty,” they were leaving $83 BILLION in U.S. military weaponry to the Taliban!

They don’t care about keeping guns out of the hands of terrorists.

_They care about keeping guns out of the hands of law-abiding Americans_!

Reading through the details of the UN “Small Arms Treaty,” it’s hard to see how our Second Amendment could survive, if ratified.

For starters, the Treaty text demands the U.S. identify “end users” (gun buyers), document “the quantity, value, and model/type” of firearms and ammunition, and develop “national control standards” to regulate transfers.

_In other words, by design it’s an International Gun Registry that’ll include detailed information on American gun owners just like you -- the first step toward outright CONFISCATION_.

Worse, all that information would be made accessible by despots and foreign governments including the Treaty's largest signer -- Communist China.

**[As you can see, it’s vital you sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators demanding they reject this scheme](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9yaimj682mil2jqfqapzp0m83qicwec5pba9w25gvlx75i429twjau26jylaygc9zj6fiizkdy0c5sto3sc94v1hu5ogv9bq9hyye4k45x7vnrwgty57wic4xeyctfh0gk3j9ptom56ux8aiqj971blx47q5x&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scrb6i)**!

Introductory language already includes: *** _Mandated national “screening” for those seeking to own guns_ , giving bureaucrats the final say on whether or not you’re “competent” enough to own a firearm; *** _Restrictive licensing for gun and ammo sales_ , and perhaps even bans on anything from semi-auto rifles to shotguns and handguns; *** _Restrictions on the number of guns and amount of ammo any “properly-licensed” individual may legally own_ ; *** _Bans on magazines holding more than ten rounds_ ; and *** _Bans on owning a firearm for self-defense_ \-- unless a citizen can somehow get government approval (which will only happen if you’re “connected” -- or paid half-a-million dollars for one of Hunter Biden’s paintings). Believe me, the United Nations has no intention of slow walking any of this.

To them, your Second Amendment freedoms are a threat to their grand “utopian” designs.

Enemies like Red China are so eager to see every American disarmed, they’re pouring money into the UN “Small Arms Treaty” hand-over-fist.

_So, it’s no wonder why they’re hell-bent on forcing the U.S. to submit to this globalist gun control scam -- and why we must defeat it_!

**[I’m counting on you to help beat the UN by signing your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9yaimj682mil2jqfqapzp9a0sfd2wgoem7n8pdj8r97dqp6atjkurta38b3n78d5hckt48a3nxds4selqy74up8m9isnwk3g4rtbpvlwdyd0dltw8ws3jn1hrvrd0f8sqd4y0v73jf4bx6ljs3qiqcv0bt7jo&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scrb6i)**.

As soon the gun grabbers have 67 votes to ratify the Treaty in the U.S. Senate, you can bet Biden’s pal, Sen. Chuck Schumer, will call for the vote.

But we can’t wait until then to fight back because even now, one-world bureaucrats are pushing these gun controls deep into every part of government.

_On top of Biden’s ATF anti-gun executive actions, a headline from _The Hill_ shows how “Democrats’ latest backdoor plan to limit gun ownership” involves new State Department “sanctions” designed to drive the price of ammo by BANNING imports_.

That’s the same State Department which NAGR caught red-handed trying to siphon your tax dollars into funding the UN “Small Arms Treaty.”

_Worse, since day one of the COVID-19 outbreak, our court system has said yes to almost any politician cooking up any unconstitutional idea so long as it’s under the guise of “public health_.”

So now Biden’s Center for Disease Control (CDC) is pushing a new Euro-centric gun control framework that says _“Using a public health approach is essential to addressing firearm violence and keeping people safe and healthy.”_

That’s why insisting that your U.S. Senators OPPOSE the ratification of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” is not enough.

We must insist that the U.S. Senate ensures that NOT ONE TAXPAYER CENT is spent by Biden on implementing any part of this Treaty or what it stands for.

But I’m counting on your help to send that message -- before it’s too late.

**[First, please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=mb37hrxl6ov9yaimj682mil2jqfqapzpv1eg8xqwhlr6ak77taymugnyg9mcqo36t9lvd6jdye23wc4nwa7hxu63t4ybdzli7qb1zveyyu9klodkl11pamu8vq9lud09bpy9m8dvexhkw5mdaihxt2ix5mkt9wxdd2smd1b3&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scrb6i)**.

Second, please agree to your most generous contribution to help the National Association for Gun Rights mobilize a grassroots firestorm against the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- using everything from _U.S. Mail_ , to _phones_ , to _email_ , _blogs_ , and _guest editorials_ , _hard-hitting video_ and even _paid media_ if we can raise resources.

If at all possible, I’m hoping you’ll agree to $100.

I know that’s a lot to ask for, believe me. But the fight is here, Fellow Patriot. It’s on. There’s no time to wait.

**[But if $100 is just too much -- even given the urgency of the situation -- please agree to $30, or at least $15 TODAY](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=8hhwj26zj0mlb5w4jj43skubbm4gnvh69n3nwlv7wr603nw9h0utbmgaizg9sju77cnldm0a9aup8454tu5gxlo43n1je8qbbuufe7inff27p9s4zh360i61yrk6hddtt1vvphr7ngzcs5l6b7f6du9inddcidd8nmiu2kmx60mu5rrfavfr3l8719rt8z99ui1ohtx&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=scrb6i)**.

Whatever you can do, please act IMMEDIATELY. There’s no time to waste.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President
National Association for Gun Rights**

* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to work towards a comfortable retirement.

# TUESDAY, APRIL 30, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this date in 1900, railroad engineer Casey Jones died in a train collision, one hand on the brake and one hand on his screaming whistle. "The Ballad of Casey Jones" made him a folk hero. ([Hear Johnny Cash's Version](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj8tqwzAQAL9GusWsdiVZOehQKKEUUij0dTOKvYoV5Cg4ik3-vqTnXmdgYL733T6knM7HtzCxr7F0oa9p4U5vCDaoOy0HH5mRSbJXrdLaAW5Jjt6YaLdkMAKrQ8vWAfRstTOkjFMqyuQRUIMmAGesahuMLZJybNH0h6BYaOAh1TI3p5LOdeSY72XhuenLJLMfa71cBT0J3Ancreva3Mut3g788A8Saj8K2i2Cnj-6n88venkNp3c5--GyppzT1bZCw3EKKf8l67-DvwEAAP__jqpP4Q)) Today's history item got us thinking about trains. With a little research, we learned that the term ["horsepower"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFztCAQgOFfgx0OLhx6BcXX2N3XpnRQVt0E4Ub2jvHfZ5I69Vu883w8poenSGn77w90vObJL0xvnIzUSoKZTBPcigioG3Rd3xkzKLjrZnca1wBhuYO9qdnO6M1dgw52Nt4CDHNDDhQYZbRSw812fQtrD7ob0MJtmX2HwigMxPlsPzMl3nGNV37j2S75aKLbmZ9F6H8CRgFjrbXdqXA-r58uYExYi4BxkLxT2oq88kse_pIps_xKuUo_5xdLPj2l0pwuPCvFSMX2wqjt8BR_R_wn-zsAAP__Ae1aJA) was coined as a marketing tool to sell early steam engines. Oddly, America's first steam locomotive lost a race to a horse. Congrats to Frankie, the _Flyover _reader who won our gift card contest! ## Students Defy University Deadline
Columbia University officials [began suspending students](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uhDAQBOCnMZ2R_8BQuEhDd2lTImOWYyNjI3vv0L19dFHKdJ80U4zm6zbfPEZM909_gKMtzz4QPmE2XAuuzGya1W0ACnQDTlppzCDUqJvdBTEuMPhB9SHYzdqhH40ONkiQ_Sg326BTQhlhtBBD10vbqs0qLQfoVRcWL4EZAStSLu13xkQ7bPGVn1DakI8mup3orEx_MDUxNV3X1aYlJLjqO2dqepOp6VH5n0KOj2NBzx8Jn1Aq0oufBSqukIhX_3o375nQE-ZU-VkyQSUolVfyMcLKa9h5CclLM9qua4pbzwtjxNpbZsT98Bh_19G_X_0EAAD__yXebe8) Monday after pro-Palestinian protestors failed to disperse by a 2 p.m. deadline imposed by the school's administration. The university [offered the students a chance](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFuhDAQAF9jd0b2eg-4wkUaukubEi1mDY4MRtg5lLw-utTpRppiNB-P8UExxX15p41dDXkkX-OTR1RWK8AR5ewCM7CV7ExnEHsNdytXZwLzBHQPSNjPmmyYuUcfAlMI3QQyOtCAGq3W_a01XQOhA2t6buHmJzIsUPMcaz6bzxz3unJI3_nJZ-PzJpNbaz2KsG8CBgHDdV2Nn8rOV3l5AcMLBQw-p8QLK0_b8VXUcebKpRa10A-pWE7iJGCQp5uPK6YUS9sJ1MtGMf2F6r_bvwEAAP__FqJbXQ) to finish the semester in good standing if they left the encampment and signed a form committing to abide by university policies. More than 300 protestors defied the deadline and at least 120 tents remained. Law enforcement officers were stationed outside the encampment, but neither they nor school officials entered the encampment. [Protest leaders said](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2O4yAUxfGnwR0RvuCvwsU27rLtlhbBB5sVBgtuEu3brzLdSFP_pKOj_5_7erchhrT_tidm9nm1jsMLq5FaSTKrabbZAwTdYG6H1phR0aSbY56mSY2mddaPW6c2g0mDlFfdg6DJd02YSZFRRis1dn073MgPpNsRPXXuYVsIo7AFzuX2N4fEB3z8l18oN5fPJs4H81WF_iVoEbTwgSPE-DFBS8K7RjCjVEELXkgh7bLgyoUFLabXqh-N_A7yKplRuUqXE4f0hOQs61VgN5mTdDlG7JDOntez4rPclHm73iHGUPtBGLWfNnx9aPjHWv8DAAD__2HvbZc) they would not be moved unless force was used.
## U.S. Marshals Killed in North Carolina
Eight police officers were [shot, three fatally](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAUheGnwRsWXC42GRi6eEvXjhbGl5gWQ4RJrL59lapjt086w5H-j-t8dTHFfHt3O9kWyux8i0-akSvBAWfsVhuIgFRHVo4S0Qi4qG6zAqUWftFidAOui7mQ0ZrWoEajcHW6ixYEoEAlhNGDHHsIIyhpaADtFyeJoaA1tlL7zxJz2yik7_Kk2vuyd8lurd0Ppt4YTAym8zz7vPhM5_HaGUwvMpgeB_-T31xNpTXiudS2ce9qSTE7XkKInurBj1Yf_otXn53Ei9FDV-16P2NK8RhGhuK2u5h-_9u_NX4CAAD__zX9Yak), while serving a warrant at a Charlotte, North Carolina home Monday, according to officials. A U.S. Marshals task force of officers from multiple agencies attempted to serve a warrant in east Charlotte when the shooting started. Three marshals were killed and four local police officers were injured, one critically. One suspect [was found dead inside the home](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8Gb1jwwIYMDF28pWtHC_BzeBUBC6NY_fsqnbuddMPpvu7r3VOm8vj0T3R9r6uPnV64aq4EB73qYXM7IqAa0EkjtbYCbmpILiiQt9kqbXcdQwhGCTTWTBtKhQjTQA4EaKGVEHaapRlhN6CkxRmmGLxEpgVu1GsbvyuVnnDPP_WFbYz1OWSXej9Opj4YLAyW67rGGM6C1_n2DJY3Mlhi8i3X3pGfqdZO5cFLbT3x6FvNVDw_aqaIDJahue24KGc6Z8O0eDw95b9a__f9NwAA__-fgFvH). Two other occupants were also found in the home and were being questioned. The gunfire began sometime around 1 p.m. and continued for several minutes. [Numerous police and emergency service](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAQQL_G7oiGYWxMQXFNulx7pUVgiOdEjIVRov37Vbbe8uk1T-_fbb0FKbI__oYn-57rGmKXF6-kDCiklcbkMzOyGdlrq4kWQGfGzVtrNC35bucE6Y7RTS5wysQ6GdQEo3gEJCADsEyzthfMFo1eeMYp3oPmgYCT9Nou_6vsfeNcvuqL2yXW51j81vtxDubPgNcBr-HY-X1-1Adal1h4wGvcQiu1d1Z7bX1TMbRaZA_q3Grtsj_UUYtEVoTJME4cZ47OwWwouhARHEO21oWx-XS8pRQ5ZzsQPJ5Byk9J__XLdwAAAP__4MRjeA) vehicles responded to the scene, shutting down the neighborhood and surrounding streets.
## List: The largest houses in America

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

**Sign up now using the secure link below, and we 'll send the Great Reset seminar lectures--absolutely free--directly to your inbox.**

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-great-reset-cca/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5ad76d3e5ce74fc49ffbf966551d3adf&_e=Esb2rH6SiKQjRO2to2sUw4TRvC7LqKHRqVCAbWi20Dt60UAcXVvK2Y8sviz07B67nS3Rxgg4O06-jI18GKyjrcBx-I5bsHpdArz0lwvgE5apbe_v0lddEV3CwEZtI41-UVPGH5CqVdhtBFnb7FWhmh-EPFjNIfFSqQ2c4HZHUrQI5hrdXpSd_qFZf1YtWlt9P04LhMzLvib4tL4skRsKL3Vi4eV_-ONYPw-GZ0ws9n8cX8UojXy0eOqv0LgJLlgYph7mvsTuzrex0ABN3alFJszhIfa_3LoLdfwLDXWAHuvFqSPl6txBovuxeXpaShV3Nf3dpC95Rgehx0Zz9FHkA0R5pD2Cf42w5rFzywO_3It1vgR9LyPbcCWa0VG-AfaTKLEdsYEphqahyY9CJcy9dg%3D%3D)

Don't miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

Use the link above to receive your Great Reset video series today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Zach Shrewsbury
subject: We have the receipts
body:
The whole country deserved better than what we got in Joe Manchin

| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetkta9KNMNpRTcRTdY6xnrJWMqf4c4Zvc_aSg8ynOzteIvg&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=043024_q1_comparison&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, My primary opponent thinks that challenging an incumbent like Joe Manchin is unacceptable. Unlike career politicians who see public office as an opportunity to advance their own influence, power, and wealth, we understand that democracy requires us to act with courage, determination, and clarity. **We knew that West Virginia and, in fact, the whole country deserved better than what we got in Joe Manchin, and that’s why we didn’t wait until it was clear this would be an open seat and a much easier race.** We were prepared to make the case to the voters that a working-class, across-the-board progressive Senator is what our country needs and not a Senator who routinely undermines not only the progressive agenda but also his own party and President.
---
[ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetkta9KNMNpRTcRTdY6xnrJWMqf4c4Zvc_aSg8ynOzteIvg&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=043024_q1_comparison&n=2)
---
Our path to victory is not dependent on what the “National Party” will or won’t do after the primary. **This is why we are running a grassroots campaign and why, according to our poll of likely voters, we are leading our main opponent by 8 percent.** In the first quarter, Manchin-backed candidate and our campaign coincidently raised about the same amount of money, but 99 percent of our funds come from small-dollar donors, while only 9 percent of our opponent's donations are grassroots. **As of today, 506 of our 8,489 donors are West Virginians, which means we are winning the hearts and minds of the very people we intend to serve—not the corporate lobbyists, wealthy donors, or corrupt political elites.**
---
[ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetkta9KNMNpRTcRTdY6xnrJWMqf4c4Zvc_aSg8ynOzteIvg&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=043024_q1_comparison&n=3)

And it’s not just the donors who fuel our campaign that matter. It’s the tremendous voter outreach and on-the-ground community engagement that gives us the confidence that we can win both the primary election and the general election in November, protecting the seat for Democrats and adding a reliably progressive voice the U.S. Senate so desperately needs. We are in the final stretch of the campaign before the primary on May 14. **[If you believe in a country with universal healthcare, tuition-free public colleges and universities, a living wage, and housing as a fundamental right and a nation that yields its power responsibly, prioritizing peace, diplomacy, and cooperation over hegemony, then double down on supporting our campaign today.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetkta9KNMNpRTcRTdY6xnrJWMqf4c4Zvc_aSg8ynOzteIvg&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=043024_q1_comparison&n=5)** With clarity of purpose, Zach

Unlike career politicians who see public office as an opportunity to advance their own influence, power, and wealth, we understand that democracy requires us to act with courage, determination, and clarity. We knew that West Virginia and, in fact, the whole country deserved better than what we got in Joe Manchin, and that’s why we didn’t wait until it was clear this would be an open seat and a much easier race. We were prepared to make the case to the voters that a working-class, across-the-board progressive Senator is what our country needs and not a Senator who routinely undermines not only the progressive agenda but also his own party and President. Our path to victory is not dependent on what the “National Party” will or won’t do after the primary. This is why we are running a grassroots campaign and why, according to our poll of likely voters, we are leading our main opponent by 8 percent. In the first quarter, Manchin-backed candidate and our campaign coincidently raised about the same amount of money, but 99 percent of our funds come from small-dollar donors, while only 9 percent of our opponent's donations are grassroots. As of today, 506 of our 8,489 donors are West Virginians, which means we are winning the hearts and minds of the very people we intend to serve—not the corporate lobbyists, wealthy donors, or corrupt political elites. | "DONATE TODAY >>" And it’s not just the donors who fuel our campaign that matter. It’s the tremendous voter outreach and on-the-ground community engagement that gives us the confidence that we can win both the primary election and the general election in November, protecting the seat for Democrats and adding a reliably progressive voice the U.S. Senate so desperately needs. We are in the final stretch of the campaign before the primary on May 14. With clarity of purpose, Zach | "DONATE $27.98 >>" | | Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) is running for the U.S. Senate seat as the only electable Democrat in the race. A native West Virginian, a Marine Corps veteran, and the grandson of a coal miner, Zach has a passion for making a difference in his community. He has seen firsthand the struggles faced by working families who are just trying to get by. Zach's military service experiences and his work as a community and climate justice organizer shaped his commitment to fighting for social and economic justice, and he's dedicated his career to making a difference in people's lives. you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to
overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement
will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won.

Nothing
could be further from the truth-the fight for life is only just
beginning!

Right

allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority
of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that
abortion should be unrestricted.

We must
stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we
don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will
continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to
advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of
the American family.

Today,
I'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe
the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to

everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the
spread of the Left's anti-life ideology. Will you take a minute
to stand with me by signing this pledge now?

I'd like
to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can
save thousands of lives from abortion over the next year.

Gratefully,
Dr. Ben

body:
Need your help | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/drscottjensen/max?e=9828080a05)
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

I don't do this often, but I'm asking you to support a young man running for Minnesota's State House in a district north of the Twin Cities (28B). Max Rymer is running and I'd like you to [donate to him](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=3b5ec3a86a&e=9828080a05) if you can. Max was at the very center of my gubernatorial campaign. I trust him. I trust him on parental rights, on education, on every pressing issue that faces our state. He's bright, energetic, and a natural leader. He's a listener and will bring needed balance to a broken state government. I hope you can [help him](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=e0d0913516&e=9828080a05), because I believe he'll make a difference in Minnesota.

Over the past 3 years, Max and I have learned so much from one another. He sharpened me as a gubernatorial candidate - and I consider us lifelong friends. If you care about the pressing issues of parental rights, health freedom, government overreach, and public safety, Max Rymer is someone I trust in Minnesota to lead effectively on these issues. [He needs your help](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=40b4b1555b&e=9828080a05) to win this election - and every small dollar [donation](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=c8775bd91d&e=9828080a05) will help.
---
| [ ](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=72ac4c0992&e=9828080a05)
---
| We are at such a pivotal moment in our state and in our country. Government is broken, censorship is encroaching, and the need for next-generation leadership is necessary. I'm writing to you today because I trust this young man to help lead Minnesota forward in his district (and beyond). If you believe in everything that I've stood for the past few years, Max Rymer has been by my side as an advisor and encourager. If you've believed in me, you can believe in him. [Help Max win in the State House.](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=25ac3b97b9&e=9828080a05)

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

Thanks to your unwavering support, we've reached a pivotal milestone — we've hit our fundraising goal, paving the way to open our inaugural campaign office right in the heart of Memphis, Tennessee. I'll be sharing more details with you later this week. Looking ahead, there's more we aim to accomplish. When we secure this U.S. Senate seat for Tennessee, it's not just a win for us — it's a victory for progressive ideals nationwide. | _Who are you partnered with?_ It's no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms compare so you can decide on the right fit for you.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=badb2a44f39a481eb54d11d67a322a7c&_e=-juBT_iMUYFMmQ-bFiuOHi1tSXFrjJsQtbhWlUIUzMxAKKJnmZyCRHUdulBSJsgkZkCSciGKwujHdC4o-Q-9XjjMsvqc-3LL2yf1esH3eU5HMS2RRkOhTdAk9Ti_pATFntXvNRqJiEqw4cJziYNqaggHof1Xj_KYuzGeuQcBXc2_Co5LYAHVHxz8feDcxrtGcIRDsfWjX5Idnhg6VsBOgZVpC75rE_swE8TYYX-3QljAHdaC84_ou8hll5Mc9XO9iGH8Xy-lBR0o5U6lONIgvyvEGfA76Qg564LLNlvGFLipvgAE6kRr3R4wJm347DD9urh31SM4Ii7phodbSQ17n2k4_tGR7WM7wsyxPSXEogZLLJUBhKJYBulxZul9WkKIokKn4SASWSNEQ2aYM8VeYv_QBd3GTxYOM_PG3LKhJw-6qWX4xv8507BEfIGkISrW)

Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, it can seem daunting to choose one. That's why SmartAsset created a [no-cost tool](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=badb2a44f39a481eb54d11d67a322a7c&_e=-juBT_iMUYFMmQ-bFiuOHjGFRgchsvEEasz4zbKxglMDb_EZZ41ppuJS8TXUALgP68MbqzieC4L41W0SQl19FcsAGOVmKvvFOnZWTGUiPE-xrADSz2Bie_4PNujxogJlDVIwsycmCkZc5WXckFsiYPEl0V2hmlnLUIfjF8zuLglKGQ57fWnhCtPubnpy80MUP-YbVogj60Xy8x1selLaReOjF2lfoWD702R8L3wdOSDHWCZMGpId2z0rPFsKxzM29alQrk41kzLL1EFR5pC7xzm4cR8UVTaHd9c-tZjvyAgydB2cp77wWYDvNGUUxokuvuIVDkvPL8J06xVfX4c8o5lEAp4HeE_PLu1Du7LYO3f2MnflTx7raOyJ19X0dNwuXgLjHsb3WVpM5Cml5dRwLXSXVQBCAISAt6nyFuFVfXc%3D) to help match you with up to three financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to work towards a comfortable retirement.

# ONE OF US - FIGHTING FOR US!

| Team Soboleski,
I trust you've seen the fantastic news to come out of the state convention last week. My message of conservative action, experience and problem solving resonated with Republican voters and activists from across our great state, earning me three new endorsements from my colleagues in the legislature.
Yesterday I was invited on and discussed my experience in the legislature with Aaron Chadbourne on the Howie Carr show.
Tonight, I hope you will tune in to the second debate with my opponent on [WGME 13 at 7:00 PM](https://eqbp6ugbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ATbd1PU4JkRfjOeol0p_jJS8nWqvM8CzNcRI8QY_inVnzJ4HcZzyW_hvvjXyREVHz7XMnZlmiKcbtqylPgWy0XYSF3oBKBFSxiSJ4QLANucaISZ8k0IKCqARjnADXOBmQ_9tir2moJKPBn5G7NRjoKbJxpwaK4vRO3Zlb8kEYdWy-MT6FwU74EHi67-C-MbTtKb0-BC_6xQtJVymBPEKinKF8WdCaNeh9H3JO_DtxnnXAPa1lUz6os7vsEZVP58EPcN46vZrWcqQp0QcKqcraMnyrKLqguHf306tX8s76cMmv6nXq5q07EUNWuaVy6Ao8auzHJ1M5LQofPFenncuGokmLwU4-qZ3BPHyZia1BA7st4wz0FPh-QGuKlOTlsR5EF0IpSZGCkgKYgrkriV92xXG_KPjbj9eLH2iPA9B5N_tzAI49YTmoOqpao_qlD2tNukAetN6mwxT57UguXJVrTZX2A9b2xKi_X4tFHWx1KXf_qpS6s1xtl8mO7kbtPU4ure_HwlBBHb3KOX8XLHxK-Ro8V7mHJoLkpklPKpi4CY=&c=QIE-tVvsVqm6bgoIkmjn6ufpiJaLcxbvzTddnC9qV3rKthHAmtEDVQ==&ch=9IHM8e_swlL2wraENo0Eo3yoKeYHhlC_ZRn3hxFvHrksgmrebGSrtQ==).
The momentum is on our side, despite advantages my opponent has secured from the political establishment and the DC swamp. He may have more campaign cash to spend on DC consultants, but I'm connecting with real people, winning the forgotten majority of conservative voters, veterans, and working families across the second congressional district day by day.
We have just six weeks to the primary election and I am asking each of you to contribute just [$5.00 today](https://eqbp6ugbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ATbd1PU4JkRfjOeol0p_jJS8nWqvM8CzNcRI8QY_inVnzJ4HcZzyW_hvvjXyREVHqaG0AN8c93A8b8c5ziULi-a9j_yot0CE0isGFgqQykGFiF3rib-3lANje2v6RwgwBtxIpDrOavt9eUB2-oRb-ZNeV1t9SfvcG1LgfQr0NzkP-1pDAjh3-A==&c=QIE-tVvsVqm6bgoIkmjn6ufpiJaLcxbvzTddnC9qV3rKthHAmtEDVQ==&ch=9IHM8e_swlL2wraENo0Eo3yoKeYHhlC_ZRn3hxFvHrksgmrebGSrtQ==).
