subject: Should Dr. Ben Carson Be Canceled?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| |
---
| | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper._mCuxQ)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country, to help him take a stand against “cancel culture.” It’s tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders – who should be acting as role models for our kids – instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by “canceling” Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It’s really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this – not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

“Cancel culture” tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn’t listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents – hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_“What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?”_

And that’s exactly what we’re doing. It’s why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place – to lead the way for what’s best for our country.

And we’ve created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country – who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you’re just such an American.

And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture – knowing that he’s broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans.

He can say ... “Enough is enough! I’m fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what’s best for the country.”

If that’s a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI’s **National Statement Against Cancel Culture**. Here’s the link again for you:

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country.

I hope you’ll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Andrew D. Hughes
Executive Director & CEO
American Cornerstone Institute

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Let me give you a few examples.
Back in 2010, I heard nearly every day a fresh example of how our health care system was utterly broken. And so I got to work with my fellow Democrats, carefully crafting a law to begin to fix what many said was unfixable. Was the result perfect? No.
But, in the Affordable Care Act, we moved a mountain that _everyone_ thought was untouchable.
**That work continues.**
I am continuing to work to lower the costs of prescription drugs. I voted to reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation, and capping the price of insulin at $35 per month.
The same is true of President Biden's infrastructure law. We identified a massive problem — a need for critical investment and job creation after some tough years of inaction. So we got to work, and got it done.
**We have a lot of work ahead of us.**
When the Supreme Court and extreme Republicans came after reproductive freedom,**I voted no because my job is to protect your ability to make decisions about your body — and to keep the politicians, judges, and radical extremists out of it.** Abortions are deeply personal medical decisions that should be between someone who is pregnant and their doctor.
Together, we sent a message to the Supreme Court that Mifepristone is a safe, effective drug used for medication abortions — and should remain legal. Abortion is health care, and people have the right to make their own decisions without government interference. This should not be political whatsoever, and a strong majority of the American people agree.
**Our objectives, from supporting our veterans and protecting voting rights, to addressing ongoing affordability crises — are achievable goals — but only with your help.**
[**A contribution of just $3 early in the Election Year can make a world of difference — will you chip in now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84029905/470278510/1596212816?refcode=2024-04-30-eom&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=50a76e0f-1007-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MGE3NmUwZi0xMDA3LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PBHBmOEz1OXJE8deNXqI3Oh6CgE5EtcnNnAz6b_iLgU=)
In gratitude,
_Rick_

clean_body: Fortifying abortion rights, lowering prescription drug prices and the costs of health care, supporting our veterans, protecting voting rights, and addressing ongoing affordability crises. | | | | I often hear from my friends and neighbors that Congress is broken and not focused on the work of the people. I understand that frustration. I can assure you that despite all the chaos you hear about I am focused on the issues that matter to you: Fortifying abortion rights, lowering prescription drug prices and the costs of health care, supporting our veterans, protecting voting rights, and addressing ongoing affordability crises. = Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = Let me give you a few examples. Back in 2010, I heard nearly every day a fresh example of how our health care system was utterly broken. And so I got to work with my fellow Democrats, carefully crafting a law to begin to fix what many said was unfixable. Was the result perfect? No. But, in the Affordable Care Act, we moved a mountain that everyone thought was untouchable. That work continues. I am continuing to work to lower the costs of prescription drugs. I voted to reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation, and capping the price of insulin at $35 per month. The same is true of President Biden's infrastructure law. We identified a massive problem — a need for critical investment and job creation after some tough years of inaction. So we got to work, and got it done. We have a lot of work ahead of us. When the Supreme Court and extreme Republicans came after reproductive freedom,I voted no because my job is to protect your ability to make decisions about your body — and to keep the politicians, judges, and radical extremists out of it. Abortions are deeply personal medical decisions that should be between someone who is pregnant and their doctor. Together, we sent a message to the Supreme Court that Mifepristone is a safe, effective drug used for medication abortions — and should remain legal. Abortion is health care, and people have the right to make their own decisions without government interference. This should not be political whatsoever, and a strong majority of the American people agree. Our objectives, from supporting our veterans and protecting voting rights, to addressing ongoing affordability crises — are achievable goals — but only with your help. = In gratitude, Rick = | | Paid for and authorized by Citizens to Elect Rick Larsen. | This email was sent by . | | **For Immediate Release:** April 30, 2023
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**US Senator Alex Padilla Endorses Dave Min**
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, California’s senior US Senator Alex Padilla announces his endorsement of Dave Min for Congress in California’s 47th Congressional District. Himself the child of immigrants, Sen. Padilla cited Min’s commitment to the values of opportunity and inclusion, as well as his backing from our public safety personnel, as reasons for offering his support and monumental endorsement.

**“The son of Korean immigrants, Dave has dedicated his life to protecting the American Dream,”** said Senator Padilla.**“From prosecuting financial crime and corruption by Wall Street banks at the Securities and Exchange Commission, to fighting for Orange County homeowners and small businesses in the State Senate, Dave is committed to building an economy that uplifts every Orange County family. I’m proud to join Firefighters, Deputy Sheriffs, and Police Officers in endorsing Dave Min.”**

The differences between Min and his opponent–MAGA Scott Baugh–could not be starker. While Baugh began his career as a corrupt State Assemblymember, engaging in campaign finance fraud, perjury, and obstruction of justice, which led to his being indicted for 22 criminal charges (including 4 felony counts), Dave Min began his career cracking down on corporate fraud and corruption as an SEC prosecutor. While Baugh has embraced whackjob conspiracy theories associated with white nationalism, stating that “wokeness” was a more dangerous threat to America’s security than 9/11 or World War II, Min has repeatedly celebrated diversity and stood up against hate in Orange County. And while Baugh has made clear that he would support a total abortion ban, without exceptions, even in the case of rape, incest, or danger to a woman’s life, Min has earned a 100% rating from Planned Parenthood and authored eight leading domestic violence bills into law.
###
_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God.
[ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e9bacb93b60f42c3a9c59fe1061575cf&_e=6EchP5WBIYSA7pUefAzWLauFJSAbt9VYV5_NcUREr0JA1iR9lEM4h9fL3oV6L5rqHLMSnKe96RHkqMZUjA6EhoraUAvzwOVynxZs-_TpXTkChKuvUcaik-lgIRTBRk7jp-_1rwN0SE7RZtud2chxzCoCavUkDVoDgnVzu21HNusILqEnmtkTY4VRlwHOUzJw_OkJp35pviwHRAH9uokPsS_iuUeW8YQ-5r4SXz0OIiInipgrixJ7zsDWoENGuLwP0r9h3FUTvVEpTCND2UcbMLYYuPSUDDxPQW4QYBX5CUtzwz57I1WVSFNWDM-HMV9ByZkUNmKEK556OQyAsvKloQBbrL71YulRlm0U6EyObfofqd24rk0jeEf-vl4B_27PuCCWRXNxcmrxD12Bf16GTX6jfyNDECE7-S4W7v24kLY%3D) Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e9bacb93b60f42c3a9c59fe1061575cf&_e=6EchP5WBIYSA7pUefAzWLauFJSAbt9VYV5_NcUREr0JA1iR9lEM4h9fL3oV6L5rqHLMSnKe96RHkqMZUjA6EhoraUAvzwOVynxZs-_TpXTkChKuvUcaik-lgIRTBRk7jp-_1rwN0SE7RZtud2chxzCoCavUkDVoDgnVzu21HNusILqEnmtkTY4VRlwHOUzJw_OkJp35pviwHRAH9uokPsS_iuUeW8YQ-5r4SXz0OIiInipgrixJ7zsDWoENGuLwP0r9h3FUTvVEpTCND2UcbMAh--f-qa4-YDWdQWMfc4zt1dloghdSBqj1KczHZTXtmDRug6GCxYwDfER1jIrVgxEspZBPMaWTwAPuecueXgOM_xv9KjhRM9kNlemOl7pIA0Kv8_g5fEv3p5roVOjMAGNQybq125yyZtpT7oIv1o-o%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

By learning about our Western roots, we add meaning and purpose to our lives and enhance our relationships with others.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e9bacb93b60f42c3a9c59fe1061575cf&_e=6EchP5WBIYSA7pUefAzWLauFJSAbt9VYV5_NcUREr0JA1iR9lEM4h9fL3oV6L5rqHLMSnKe96RHkqMZUjA6EhoraUAvzwOVynxZs-_TpXTkChKuvUcaik-lgIRTBRk7jp-_1rwN0SE7RZtud2chxzCoCavUkDVoDgnVzu21HNusILqEnmtkTY4VRlwHOUzJw_OkJp35pviwHRAH9uokPsS_iuUeW8YQ-5r4SXz0OIiInipgrixJ7zsDWoENGuLwP0r9h3FUTvVEpTCND2UcbMMeTMWbKgiYiIbFNJkPkdFRftqUjzq9HM8e8_Wp-dFEG6a9szXALoIlbRvVo7u_FgDjfMR2hiH-tzzj3ZObDReU6xFMipxcEgiR39-ts9IN-Wy4VBIklwCobDX97YrSyn4_FLNaXY7uHZLB3w2PiZEw%3D)**

As a person involved in the fight for fair maps you already know we’re facing an inflection point in our country — and that we need to do everything in our power to ensure that our democracy endures.

And voters as a whole grasp what’s at stake, too. In fact, new polling from NBC News and Hart Research importantly shows that the top issue influencing how people will actually vote this year is not inflation, is not immigration but is “protecting democracy”.

The NDRC is leading the charge to meet this moment and elect candidates who will defend our democracy, but we’ve got work to do to ensure voters know this issue is important not only in the presidential election but in races all the way down the ballot.

[**Can I count on you to support our work by making a donation today so we can be successful this November and beyond?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84033933/470292024/-803236760?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_aprfun_email_20240430-NDRC-Red-HolderNBC_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240430-NDRC-Red-HolderNBC_&utm_campaign=aprfun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRiYmM1YjM1LTE1MDctZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fk-iHslQeUzQmrWl5WFJT35ShlK_DN-ow0kzO5LYuXs=)

Some pundits have claimed that voters don’t care about preserving democracy. This poll shows how that notion is utter nonsense.

But now we must connect the dots between defending democracy and electing state legislators and governors who support fair maps, and fair-minded state supreme court justices who will protect voters against the manipulation of our democratic systems.

State-level races don’t get as much attention as they deserve, and voters are often unable to find information on what’s at stake. That’s where we come in, with our targeted investments in the most important races that will make the biggest difference to shore up free and fair elections.

The good news is that this poll shows voters will be receptive to our message. We just have to make sure they hear it.

What we do between now and Election Day could be the difference in securing a future in which everyone is equally represented in our nation’s democracy, or a future where extremist politicians can bend the rules in their favor to subvert the will of the voters and cement minority rule.

The very fabric of our democracy is on the line. Voters know it — and they also know that when we protect democracy, we’ll be able to advance the values we care about like access to health care, women’s reproductive freedom, justice reform, climate protection, LGBTQ+ rights, and so much more.

But now we need to get our pro-democracy candidates over the line and ensure fair maps for a truly representative democracy. [**So please, make a donation to the NDRC today!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84033935/470292033/-803236760?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_aprfun_email_20240430-NDRC-Red-HolderNBC_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240430-NDRC-Red-HolderNBC_&utm_campaign=aprfun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRiYmM1YjM1LTE1MDctZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fk-iHslQeUzQmrWl5WFJT35ShlK_DN-ow0kzO5LYuXs=)

body:
#
Friend — I am reaching out to humbly ask you to make a $3 contribution to The Long Run before our April end-of-month deadline comes to a close at midnight today.
Honestly speaking, April has been a tough month for fundraising. We leaned on this team and pushed as hard as possible to support candidates in Primary elections the past few months — _But since then, our movement has been losing the steady support it needs._
This movement has proven time and time again that it can be consequential in key races, so we cannot afford to slow down.
[**So please. If you can afford it, please make a $3 contribution to The Long Run today. Every dollar will help us make a greater impact around the country.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-apr24.czsms6&refcode=em240430-1-t12&t=1&akid=5292%2E196590%2EF_3luv)

It’s Julianna here. I’ve just learned that we’re only 179 grassroots donations away from our critical end-of-month fundraising goal.

This is make-or-break, and we can't afford to fall short. If we don't reach our target, we won't have enough funds to launch the crucial ads in the final months before Election Day that support President Biden's agenda. We need your help to make sure every single voter out there gets the message loud and clear.

Julianna

Unite the Country

Peter,
On Friday, South Dakota Governor and aspiring Trump running mate Kristi Noem released a preview of her memoir. In it, she bragged about shooting and killing a 14-month-old puppy and a goat, then throwing them into a gravel pit.
After the story went viral, Noem defended her actions, comparing the horrific killings to the responsibilities she faced in politics.
**According to her logic, she thought that killing her puppy made her the most qualified candidate to be Trump’s VP.**
Peter, if you’ve noticed an escalation in the Republican obsession with violence, you’d be correct.
[**We’ll explain more in a minute, but today is our end-of-month deadline, and we’re trying to raise a record-breaking $25,000 to counter the dangerous rhetoric on the right. **That reason is Donald J. Trump.** Remember when he told supporters to attack journalists at his rallies? Or, just last month, when he said the January 6th rioters were “hostages,” even though they stormed the Capitol, attacked police officers, and threatened to hang Mike Pence?
All the while, right-wing media like Fox News and Tucker Carlson cheered Trump on to millions of Republican voters. **They normalized violent rhetoric to such an extreme degree that Governor Noem actually thought a story about brutally killing a puppy would help her secure the Republican Vice Presidential nod. **
But, Peter, Noem wasn’t even the only Republican trafficking in violent rhetoric last week.
During a rally, MAGA Republican Arizona Senate candidate Kari Lake **told supporters to “strap on a Glock” to prepare for the 2024 election.**
And Arkansas Senator Tom Cotton took to Twitter/_X_ last week to tell people to “take matters into your own hands” when dealing with protestors. **On a Fox News program, he encouraged members of the public to throw protesters off of bridges and tear the skin off of their fingers.**
This type of rhetoric isn’t just morally disgraceful; it’s dangerous. It’s why we had January 6th. It’s why Nancy Pelosi’s 82-year-old husband was attacked in his own home by an assailant with a hammer.

In it, she bragged about shooting and killing a 14-month-old puppy and a goat, then throwing them into a gravel pit. After the story went viral, Noem defended her actions, comparing the horrific killings to the responsibilities she faced in politics. According to her logic, she thought that killing her puppy made her the most qualified candidate to be Trump’s VP. That reason is Donald J. Trump. Remember when he told supporters to attack journalists at his rallies? Or, just last month, when he said the January 6th rioters were “hostages,” even though they stormed the Capitol, attacked police officers, and threatened to hang Mike Pence? All the while, right-wing media like Fox News and Tucker Carlson cheered Trump on to millions of Republican voters. They normalized violent rhetoric to such an extreme degree that Governor Noem actually thought a story about brutally killing a puppy would help her secure the Republican Vice Presidential nod. name: David Hogg
subject: Here's what we've been upto
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We can’t do the work we do without meeting these goals.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240430-1&t=1&akid=630%2E587540%2Elp0l0g)
It’s a busy day at the end of a busy month, Peter, but you (like I am) are probably a little tired of random-feeling, largely unspecific emails asking for money from tons of groups. So, I wanted to send you a longer email telling you what we have been up to this month and at the end, if you are willing, ask if you will consider donating.
**The first week of April,** I started going to Pennsylvania to meet with young people at Penn State to talk about the importance of voting and running for office. Then in the middle of the week Kevin, the co-founder of Leaders We Deserve, and I were working on helping one of our candidates find a campaign manager now that their budget enabled them to do so. Then, Advisory Board Member, congressional candidate, and hero, Harry Dunn happened to be near our office, so we caught up with him and chatted about how his race was going.
**The second week of April,** I went to New Hampshire to debate a Libertarian gun rights activist on gun control at Dartmouth. I also discussed running for office with some young people in NH, where Leaders We Deserve is planning some endorsements soon. I also got to celebrate my birthday (thanks to all of you who donated)!
**The third week of April,** I went to Houston to work with our endorsed candidate, Molly Cook, who is running for TX State Senate against someone who voted to not only arm teachers but give them $25,000 for doing so. If elected, Molly would be the youngest person in the State Senate and the most progressive. With Molly, I launched the largest canvas of the campaign, with over 45 people knocking doors with us, and hosted a fundraiser that raised nearly $10,000. Next, we went to Atlanta to work with Leaders We Deserve endorsed candidate, Bryce Berry — who would be the youngest person in the state legislature and the first ever public school teacher in the legislature. We hosted a fundraiser with Bryce that raised over $15,000 for his race. The next day, I spoke at the Cobb County Democratic Gala about the importance of not giving up on the South and the legacy of incredible leaders who have come out of Georgia.
**In the last week of April,** we went to Orlando, Florida, to officially endorse Nate Douglas for his run in one of the most competitive seats for the Florida state legislature. Nate is a climate activist and, at 23 years old, would be the youngest in the state legislature. Kevin and I spent the rest of the week working on our next slate of endorsements. One of which, we were calling to let him know we were endorsing, and he texted to say “Sorry I can’t talk right now, repealing the abortion ban in my state.” Rest assured, we got him on the phone the next day and let him know we were endorsing.
I know this email was long, but I just wanted to let you know what we have been up to! And more than anything, say thank you. **Thank you for believing in Leaders We Deserve and helping make the dream of bringing in the next generation of Leaders a reality.** We have a LOT of work to do and a long way to go but everyday I do this work, I feel something I often haven’t in the past — hope. And I know if I am feeling hopeful, we are on the right path.
I’m so thankful that I asked our team to set up a system where I can call some of you to thank you personally. But we do need help to meet our end-of-month goal.
**So if you want the chance to hear from me and chat, will you pitch in $5 or more before tonight's deadline?**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240430-1](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240430-1?refcode=em20240430-1&amount=5&refcode2=630_587540_lp0l0g&akid=630%2E587540%2Elp0l0g)**
Thanks again,
David
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20240430-1&t=2&refcode2=630_587540_lp0l0g&akid=630%2E587540%2Elp0l0g)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=3&akid=630%2E587540%2Elp0l0g)

* [Unsubscribe](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=630%2E587540%2Elp0l0g)

611 Pennsylvania Ave SE

Washington, DC 20003

| | $ **Let's Talk Tax Reform** $
**_Date:_** Friday, May 3, 2024
_**Time:**_ 2:30pm-4pm
_**Location:**_ Nebraska State Capitol
1445 'K' St - 2nd Floor
(Warner Legislative Chamber)

[](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=c148253bce&e=25844e23a8)

The time is now to bring _all_ **VOICES** to the table. Not just special interests organizations, but the PEOPLE of Nebraska who provide the REVENUE source for all levels of government. Any large entity does not out weigh the sum of the PEOPLE. Nebraskans are financially at a brink and taxation without representation, is tyranny, PERIOD! Eliminating unconstitutional and burdensome taxes is a WIN for the everyday, hard-working Nebraskan.

✅ **Control Spending**. Spending control is the best way to reform taxes and keep them balanced between NEEDS & WANTS. Our taxation problem will only be solved when the government at every level remembers that they are a NON-PROFIT organization whose sole income is the PEOPLE of Nebraska. We need to continue to limit the growth of **spending** in state & local government and elect leaders that know how to **budget**.

The voice of the people will ALWAYS be through the State and County Parties. In January of 2023, the NEGOP State Central Committee approved the following Resolution of Support for the EPIC option.

**_Resolution of Supporting EPIC Option_** **WHEREAS, the Nebraska GOP Fiscal Responsibility plank states, “We encourage our state leaders to continue to pursue the reduction of taxes for the benefit of our state...and to reduce property, sales and income tax;” ** **WHEREAS, the Nebraska GOP Economic Development plank opposes “burdensome taxes and regulations that unduly interfere with and impede free market economics”; ** **WHEREAS, the Nebraska GOP Economic Development plank supports “the establishment of fair and equitable policies of taxation and promotion of business expansion”; ** **WHEREAS, the Nebraska GOP Economic Development plank supports “home-ownership because it expands personal liberty, builds communities, and helps Americans create wealth”; ** **WHEREAS, the Beacon Hill Institute, a reputable economic think tank from Boston, MA, has conducted a series of static and dynamic economic studies for the Nebraska EPIC Option Consumption Tax and has calculated the initial EPIC Option Consumption Tax rate to be less than 7.25% on retail products and services purchased by consumers in Nebraska; ** **WHEREAS, the Beacon Hill Institute dynamic study calculated the EPIC Option Consumption Tax to be revenue neutral compared to our current broken 3-legged stool state tax structure; ** **WHEREAS, the EPIC Option Consumption Tax will eliminate Nebraska’s current burdensome tax system of property tax, personal income tax, corporate income tax, state sales tax, and inheritance tax and replace it with a consumption tax on retail products and services purchased by consumers; ** **WHEREAS, there will be no EPIC Option Consumption Tax paid on business-to-business transactions; ** **WHEREAS, the elimination of burdensome property taxes will provide a major economic relief for Nebraska agriculture which is the largest industry in our state; ** **WHEREAS, the elimination of property taxes will remove a huge annual financial burden from retirees living off a fixed income and families who are raising their children; ** **WHEREAS, the EPIC Option is a double petition drive that started on January 1, 2023, to gather the 125,000+ valid voter signatures required to place each of two petitions on the November 2024 general election ballot. The first petition states: “Notwithstanding any other provision of this Constitution, beginning January 1, 2026, no governmental entity in the State of Nebraska may impose taxes other than retail consumption taxes or excise taxes.”; and, ** **WHEREAS, the second petition states: “beginning on January 1, 2026, the State of Nebraska shall impose a retail consumption tax or an excise tax on all new goods and services, and the Legislature ** **may authorize political subdivisions to do the same. There shall be no exemption from such taxes except for grocery items purchased for off-premises consumption.” ** **Now, therefore, be it RESOLVED, that the Nebraska Republican Party State Central Committee Members: ** **The EPIC Option Consumption Tax should be fully supported by the Nebraska Republican Party because it meets several of our existing platform planks, eliminates our current burdensome state tax structure, and removes obstacles currently limiting the economic engine of Nebraska. ** **ADOPTED ** **NEGOP State Central Committee, January 21, 2023 **

clean_body: Photos attached >> Hi Peter, As we reach the end of Care Workers Recognition Month, we’re so proud of everything our movement has done to highlight the value of care workers. ⇨ After a series of events for Care Workers Recognition Month, the Biden‐Harris Administration announced final rules designed to protect those in long‐term care and enhance the quality of caregiving jobs. ⇨ We held a Care Townhall on investing in care with Acting Secretary of Labor Julie Su and members of Congress including Senator Elizabeth Warren (D‐MA), Senator Bernie Sanders (I‐VT), Senator Bob Casey (D‐PA), and House Democratic Whip Katherine Clark (D‐MA). ⇨ Rep. Pramila Jayapal joined domestic worker organizers to discuss the need for care infrastructure in our economy. ⇨ We launched wheatpaste posters around Washington, D.C. to make it clear to politicians and the media that our voices matter in this election, and care cannot wait. ⇨ And supporters like you sent over 1,400 messages to Senators this month to pass the Child Tax Credit expansion, which would lift up working‐class families. Our celebration and recognition of care workers does not end today, Peter. Here are three ways you can help us make a difference for workers and families in this critical election year: Thank you for being with us, Care in Action

Over the weekend, the House voted to send Ukraine funding for a security package to help fight off the unjustified invasion ordered by Vladimir Putin.
Over 100 House Republicans, led by Marjorie Taylor Greene, voted against the Ukraine funding measure. Chief among them was one of Putin’s most reliable and talkative puppets: Jim Jordan.
It has already been exposed that Jordan was the architect of the failed impeachment effort of President Biden. Jordan hand-picked the man that the GOP chose as their star witness, Alexander Smirnov, whose complete and total lies were shown to be fabrications fed by Russian intelligence. Jordan eagerly accepted these lies with no evidence—happily doing Putin’s bidding if it served his and Trump’s interest.
This is why we say as often as possible that Jim Jordan is a threat to our national security and cannot be trusted in office. He has already endangered us, and he will do even more and worse if we allow him to return to Congress.
That’s why I am giving everything I have to this campaign. I am doing this for all of us, every American everywhere. The people of my district deserve a leader who will fight for them, and America needs us to run strong and win this crucial race.
Jordan will continue to abuse his power and put us all at risk if we don’t leave it all on the field in our work to defeat him. So I’m asking, as directly as possible: with so much at stake, can I count on you to stand with us and work to beat Jim Jordan in November for the good of the entire country? **CAMPAIGN UPDATES FOR APRIL 30, 2024**
We're turning up the heat as we close in on the primary \- only 42 days away! Have you registered to vote Republican? Click below to register. _**[REGISTER TO VOTE REPUBLICAN](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/krxgxyWMNTwUUFkZETDS892A/SdQZR763qFHttC54763z5XUaAg/aZB2KtoEsWcQHwHgRcGYiw)**_ SPECIAL NOTE: Team Larsen has some exciting happenings very soon. **" COFFEE WITH CANDIDATES" TOUR WAS SUCCESSFUL!**
| Flemming appreciated the wonderful opportunity to gain more supporters, volunteers and new voters! We are thrilled to have additional followers on Team Larsen!
---

|
---
**KNOCKING ON DOORS DAILY**

This past week, Team Larsen was again beating the streets of Congressional District 1! The team is focused on talking directly with your neighbors and friends. The team visited over 300 homes and put up an additional two dozen signs! We would love to have you join us out in the community. If you are interested in participating with Team Larsen in our grassroots, canvassing connections, please reach out to Bette Schanafelt at bette@larsen4nevada.com
|

**SIGNS & PROMOTING FLEMMING LARSEN**

More and more signs continue to go up all over Congressional District 1. Campaign signs influence how we vote more than you might realize. Signs provide a sense of name recognition and convey a sense of viability and electability. Signs are an important part of this campaign, and we need donations to continue pursuing the marketing efforts we have already started. If you would like to contribute by displaying a yard sign, please contact Christina Davis at [christina@larsen4nevada.com](mailto:christina@larsen4nevada.com). If you would like to donate in support of our larger signs, please click here: [Donate Today!](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/krxgxyWMNTwUUFkZETDS892A/vWVt763BNI6PTNhjLC0vXNHg/aZB2KtoEsWcQHwHgRcGYiw)

**PIGS IN THE PARK EVENT**

This was a fantastic family event at the Paseo Verde park on April 27! Everyone loved the petting zoo, gaga ball, balloon animals and the face painting. Of course, the Larsen Firetruck is always a hit! Another hugely successful event for folks to get to know their local candidates!

That's why I created the American Cornerstone Institute to advocate for commonsense solutions to these issues and to strengthen the bonds that keep our nation united. But we can't do it alone.

I want to personally invite you to participate in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

Your responses are confidential and will be used solely towards furthering our advocacy efforts.

For Liberty,

Dr. Ben Carson

Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d04b325bd52242ee9383b7504f73fb3b&_e=7IbTsXpD6yc_478063SJWF3CgRqVKT8IjQDrcH9cd5nXeJ5nSNQm5WPl1Ei7bbT3mpE7woJ6-Bh8giCyts2QK9eCugbenURuh7n1OWrjWM5ZuAqQ1vmIk54QhWJxPkDnie-PvgsJkckgrmZhnFuQH9AOXQaqv8deQ4ZE_IFA6-yMhNLoCFH7CFUXHkihDAdiUIm9H6BWw3fNbsUf345KdH_6St1y-OAtmCpH4nNEGqaXhq4fR56LdjgPGVi_2ONmrwlACFKvVrfFhZ1dcGoobtufcqBYl6JgfZ2_9__vzkxGFYHPM5iLBFcKRDBLlzY9_zwXp8JYwVofGlpyID2kDS83fwsvLebgCGrOhhLyUVJKTwNwg61AzWdY26BYOmx-_OsWjSSmjDVLvFn2tXovW07GzPMRROvESB8-7MOoocg%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

I aim to be transparent with you every time I’m in touch. Not only because it’s what’s right but because that’s who I am.

**So, please hear me clearly:** The stakes could not be higher when the Senate majority is on the line.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

1. Yesterday, I emailed a list of supporters explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say the results it yielded were underwhelming is an understatement. My plea for help raised just $273. **[link to donate](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d04b325bd52242ee9383b7504f73fb3b&_e=7IbTsXpD6yc_478063SJWF3CgRqVKT8IjQDrcH9cd5nXeJ5nSNQm5WPl1Ei7bbT3mpE7woJ6-Bh8giCyts2QK9eCugbenURuh7n1OWrjWM5ZuAqQ1vmIk54QhWJxPkDnie-PvgsJkckgrmZhnFuQH9AOXQaqv8deQ4ZE_IFA6-yMhNLoCFH7CFUXHkihDAdiUIm9H6BWw3fNbsUf345KdH_6St1y-OAtmCpH4nNEGqaXhq4fR56LdjgPGVi_2ONmrwlACFKvVrfFhZ1dcGoobqIKOggJq2B_QazM8bmRKvzhK0O9J3c6Fn0rJF9k0lI8xwOEbaWKj7J55VbaPxYy3kluB_NHOBoMxyd1ugcNEADtSFCuw8ZdxZcW0xHKigi6hCOZWDhAVzPxAPeQNHtGDldHQLZ1rF6ZijpAHBE_95k%3D)->**

2. We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

3. Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6358%2E5257348%2E_H0i6B ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, I know
I’ve been sharing a lot of old photos recently, but I just had to send
this to you.

Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=apr2024_abs_em.I2BRAI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240430_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6358%2E5257348%2E_H0i6B ]Adam Schiff at his Bar Mitzvah

I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow
tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity
to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the
Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the
last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix.
It’s been my cause.

Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to
ask — [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=apr2024_abs_em.dQ7TDg&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240430_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=6358%2E5257348%2E_H0i6B ]will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to my
campaign? If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read
on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my
father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman
and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.

We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in
Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out
of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during
the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing,
and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.

This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in
Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the
Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I
even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of
that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)

While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly
lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.

In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but
to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.

These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to
pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key
priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is
applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and
stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.

And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our
democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.

That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the
cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up
in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=apr2024_abs_em.I2BRAI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240430_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=18&t=1006&akid=6358%2E5257348%2E_H0i6B ]If these priorities resonate with you, I’m asking for your help to

clean_body: [ ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek, I know I’ve been sharing a lot of old photos recently, but I just had to send this to you. Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: [ ]Adam Schiff at his Bar Mitzvah I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith. Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause. Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask — [ ]will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to my campaign? If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it. I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company. We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school. This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.) While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day. In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God. These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office. And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours. That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day. [ ]If these priorities resonate with you, I’m asking for your help to continue that work by chipping in $18 or another meaningful amount to my campaign. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: [ ]EXPRESS DONATE $18 [ ]EXPRESS DONATE $25 [ ]EXPRESS DONATE $50 [ ]EXPRESS DONATE $100 [ ]EXPRESS DONATE $250 [ ]ANOTHER AMOUNT Hopefully, this photo helped brighten your day and gave you a bit more insight into why I have dedicated my life to this cause. body:
#
Heyyyy Derek, it’s John.
With the PA primary in the rearview mirror, we’re *officially* in the 2024 general election between my friend Bob Casey and Connecticut mega-millionaire Dave McCormick. **It’s one of the most important races in the country.**
**[Before I get into it, can you split a contribution between our campaign and Bob Casey so he can start the election off strong? PA will make or break control of the Senate this year — so we’re counting on you. 🙏](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240430?refcode=em20240430-8959&refcode2=8959_434096_yJh_hR&akid=8959%2E434096%2EyJh_hR)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240430?amount=5&refcode=em20240430-8959&refcode2=8959_434096_yJh_hR&akid=8959%2E434096%2EyJh_hR)**
Pennsylvania is a battleground this year + every year — **and the GOP knows it.** They’re already throwing everything they’ve got into their effort to flip our Commonwealth red. 😨
This is going to be a *seriously* tough race. I know from our campaign in 2022 that Bob is going to need a strong team to stand up to McCormick’s mega-million$ and win.
If we’re going to keep the Senate blue 🔵, we need to have Bob’s back right now.
**[We made history in 2022 — let’s do it again in 2024. Split a donation of any amount right away to keep Bob in the Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240430?refcode=em20240430-8959&refcode2=8959_434096_yJh_hR&akid=8959%2E434096%2EyJh_hR)**

Thanks to your help, Bob and I are fighting for working PA families in the Senate. Let’s keep it that way. 💪
THANK YOU!!
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

| | April 30, 2024

Dear Friend, Inflation is skyrocketing, college campuses are becoming hotbeds of hate, our borders remain insecure, homelessness is out of control, and crime rates continue to trouble our communities. The real question is, who has the answers?

**_According to a recent CNN poll, Americans believe that Republicans have the answer._** Our track record of championing free markets, fiscal responsibility, strong national defense, tough-on-crime policies, and secure borders speaks volumes about our commitment to real solutions.

As you know, I'm Michael Maher, and I'm running for U.S. Congress in California's 21st district to bring new opportunities, resources, and change through conservative values. I'm a local business owner, educated here in the Valley and abroad. I'm a veteran of the U.S. Navy and former FBI Special Agent who not only understands the troubles we are facing but has the passion and real world experience to lead our community to a better tomorrow.

But I can't do it alone. I need your endorsement and contribution to secure victory in November.

I am proud to have the support of influential leaders like _**former National Security Adviser Robert O’Brien, Congressman John Duarte, Congressman Tom McClintock, former California Secretary of State Bill Jones, and many others.**_ The momentum is on our side, and our district is ready for a shift towards conservative principles.

However, we are a bit behind on meeting our April budget, and I need your help. Can you chip in with $20, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford?
---

Our dedicated volunteers in Fresno and Tulare County are hitting the ground every weekend, talking to voters, and spreading our message. We cannot afford to let them down.

Please consider making a contribution to my campaign _**before midnight TONIGHT**_ and _**forward this email to someone you know**_ who wants to see change in the right direction. Together, we will win this seat and make a lasting impact on our nation's future.

Sincerely,

Businessman | Veteran | Republican for Congress

Michael and his wife Anne, who comes from a local multigenerational valley farming family, live in Fresno County where their two children attend local public school and where Michael owns and operates his aviation business. _

_Maher is a United States Navy veteran, and served abroad the USS Salt Lake City, a Los Angeles Class Fast Attack Submarine. Following the Navy, Michael graduated from Fresno Pacific University and then was accepted and graduated from FBI Academy in Quantico, Virginia. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America’s most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife — the first pro-life diaper company — to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you’re tired of supporting brands that don’t align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
Is this something you can do? Here’s your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers— and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There’s only a few hours to go and we haven’t been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._GkzvunabwCnA)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

Friend,

I hope this message finds you well.

First things first, I gotta tip my hat to you for the incredible support you showed in 2023 and to start off this year.

**_[Your generosity made me happier than a penguin in an ice chest, and I can’t thank you enough.](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=b18a6dd3f9e840b3aa10d9396fc4c335&_e=G3a1Tzhp3QShxomhwmb16Nf5Nd-rxkn5lZc4SE6iAjkNKHpXgJDKtcUv4doqrkJExhWDOPbHg9zmwZuZ9mTS49cIp51y0OiaEr6s_-6AHo5nJFwk_mMkmkfMjjG-C1Q6bdgw_cj4gzOTp0602Bb8G2ys5ij0FHYdXN-BeynRtSDz1P_inRUhyio57i08gbBMgyvVg1sBE1G78wTRgJRmpMVFBrPzW0rZorV0_lqAaSGuuKeViF1fvkmI1rJJOMs8Eem3zIp7qSpMjrU-RQHL29QybPk36ZB4BV326fMK1bIOassKCfvs1vA873mEXv2_veAR8D_8Q2cTx74Wszb_Vnk85niBf7MiMZK9oV-cGaqhnDfpb9czecCRVrBahEYzEAoP_vc4U8yGIukscUnuNw%3D%3D)_**

Now, my mamma has always taught me to be grateful, and I hate to be asking for favors. It just doesn’t sit right with me, but there’s too much at stake.

This latest deadline slipped through my fingers, and the Radical Left caught wind. **They’re unleashing a storm, calling in the big guns and dumping truckloads of cash into their campaigns, all in an attempt to take me down and, push their Socialist Agenda & keep us from ever regaining a Senate Majority.**

| | Reproductive Freedom Week of Action
(April 27 - May 5)
---
| Reproductive freedom is on the ballot this November. President Biden and Vice President Harris are the only candidates in this race fighting to restore our rights and protect reproductive health care access in all 50 states. That’s why this week, the Biden-Harris campaign is launching a Reproductive Freedom Week of Action (April 27 - May 5) to connect with voters about the stakes of this election for our rights and reproductive health care. Here are three ways you can take action this week – or any week! – to reelect President Biden and Vice President Harris and defend reproductive freedom.
* HOST AN EVENT such as a HOUSE PARTY or a MEET-UP. Bring together the people you love and talk about the stakes of this election for reproductive freedom. Check out this**[House Party Guide](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=a2f80371b6&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **to get started! If you know students who want to get involved, share this**[campus toolkit](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=b1e3c9044d&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**.
* SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER: Go to**[JoeBiden.com/Freedom](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=950e90d361&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **to sign up and get involved with the campaign – and share the link with all your friends and family.
* POST ON SOCIAL MEDIA about the stakes of this election for reproductive freedom. Share a direct-to-camera video about where you were when the Supreme Court’s Dobbs opinion leaked and the stakes of the election this November.

Check out the**[REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM WEEK OF ACTION TOOLKIT](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=0e6d2a9fa6&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **for more resources!

| _**Earth Day 2024**_
Last week, President Biden traveled to Prince William Forest Park in Triangle, VA, a national park system site developed by FDR’s Civilian Conservation Corps, to announce $7 billion in awards through EPA’s Solar for All program and to unveil major steps to advance the American Climate Corps. You can read more about the historic climate action steps the Biden-Harris Administration has taken**[here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=fd829ace4c&e=d6c5c7d7ec).**
---
|
---
|
_**One Year Anniversary of President Biden's Care Executive Order**_
Earlier this month, the White House hosted a Making Care Work event on the one year anniversary of the **[Care Executive Order](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e3fb958dd5&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **to discuss the importance of supportive services, including child care and long-term care, for building a skilled, diverse workforce. Participants included: White House Domestic Policy Advisor Neera Tanden, Director of the Gender Policy Council Jennifer Klein, Secretary of Commerce Gina Raimondo, and Administrator of the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Shailen Bhatt. Read the fact sheet**[here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=389a966519&e=d6c5c7d7ec). **
---
|
---
|
_**Vice President Harris Participates in a Bipartisan Safer Communities Act Moderated Conversation**_

You can watch the conversation**[here ](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=f508a10606&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**and read the remarks**[here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=161c721bba&e=d6c5c7d7ec).**

name: Carmen Goers
subject: Uphold Justice in the 8th with Carmen Goers
body:
Join the Team

| | | | | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **Uphold Justice in the 8th**
**with Carmen Goers**
---

Dear Peter,
Tomorrow, as we observe National Law Day, we celebrate our nation’s commitment to the rule of law and the principles of justice that form the cornerstone of our democracy. In Washington’s 8th district, our campaign is at the forefront of upholding these values, advocating for fairness, equality, and justice for all our citizens.
The rule of law is not just a legal principle but the foundation for our community's security and prosperity. For far too long, we have had leaders in Congress that don’t take time to really consider their actions and the effects that it has on our average citizen.
In Congress, I will carefully consider each bill thoroughly and will vote how the people of my district want me to vote, not the special interest groups.
---
| | | |
---
| Recognizing this important day, we ask you to join in our commitment to justice by supporting my campaign.

Your donation of $25, $50, or $100 will empower us to continue fighting for legislative reforms that protect and enhance the rights of every individual in our district.

---
| [ DONATE TODAY! ](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/ce/c/652845d9aa222127cf458b43/662fed9697fd9ead35f64fe8/66314cd24f05433e207f4359?signature=34882c04b63a3069aa9bfa9acc600147db1a3b1030ad1a6595410a39d56f79e3)
---
| | | Let’s honor National Law Day by ensuring we have leaders who respect the law and work tirelessly to improve it. Support our campaign today, and together, we can build a district that stands as a beacon of justice and fairness.
Thank you for your dedication to our community's future.

With gratitude,

Team Carmen Goers

---

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: We see every day that November’s election is so important
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
The stakes for 2024 are high. You know that. We see that every single day. This month, we have observed the threats to American democracy and to our freedom in so many ways.
Just this month, the Arizona Supreme Court issued a ruling reinstating a 160-year-old abortion ban that puts patients in need of care and doctors who provide that care at risk. In New York, the historic criminal trial of a former U.S. President began while in Washington the U.S. Supreme Court heard arguments about whether the President should have absolute immunity from criminal prosecution.
In legislatures across the country, we see continued attacks on freedom. And in Congress, we’ve seen utter dysfunction as some House Republicans continue with their effort to oust the Speaker of the House again. They do so, in part, because the House Speaker let the House vote on a bill to provide aid to our allies in Ukraine fighting for democracy and self-determination against Russia. That is, Ukrainians are fighting for fundamental American values.
I voted for that bill, and last week, President Biden signed it into law. We can be glad about that while at the same time recognizing that it did not have to happen as it did—long delayed and thwarted time and again. The consequences of the delays are real. As are the threats to democracy. And all of this is on the ballot.
Each week, we see how important it is that Democrats take back the House, gain ground in the Senate, and hold on to the White House so that we can ensure responsible leadership focused on what matters most to the American people.
I know from experience that we can meet this moment and change the course we are on, but we can only do it when each of us shows up in every way we can. On this team, that includes our work to defend this seat in 2024 and to help take back the House and hold the Senate.
We’re working as hard as ever to do our part, and that means reaching the goals we set, including our April fundraising goal. Our deadline is midnight tonight. If you can help, I hope you will consider making a contribution before the end of the night. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240430?refcode=lpfe240430]
Together, we can do anything,
LizzieSignature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

Hi there,

body:
[1]Powered By People

I’ve been on the road for the last five days, recruiting and meeting
volunteers to help us expand our voter registration program. From San
Angelo, where we registered students on the campus of Angelo State, I’ve
traveled to Waco, College Station, Austin, San Marcos, San Antonio,
Weslaco, Portland and am writing this to you from my hotel room in Corpus
Christi.

It’s been a beautiful drive so far. There’s nothing like springtime in
Texas. Wildflowers blooming on the side of the road, rain-soaked fields
and farms in Central Texas, everything coming to life.

At each stop, I’ve had the chance to meet with volunteers to talk about
what we’re each willing to do to stop the bad things happening in Texas
and make the great things possible. It’s clear that it begins with
registering eligible Democrats and then staying in touch with them all the
way through the election. It’s encouraging to find so many who are so
willing to do the necessary work, like becoming a Volunteer Deputy
Registrar and spending the time meeting eligible voters where they are.
Because that’s what it’s going to take for us to elect good people to
power. We know it’s only a matter of time and effort – the more of us
willing to put in the effort, the sooner we’ll get there.

In San Antonio I met with some of our key volunteers who have been
registering voters at San Antonio College. Beyond the number of young
Texans that they’re adding to the roles, what impressed me was how this
group of complete strangers are now friends, working together in common
and creating a community organized around action and progress.

That’s the spirit of Texas.

I’m going to stay on the road for another week. Richmond, Houston, Fort
Worth, Denton, Abilene, Lubbock and some in between.

Beto

It’s been a beautiful drive so far. There’s nothing like springtime in Texas. Wildflowers blooming on the side of the road, rain-soaked fields and farms in Central Texas, everything coming to life. At each stop, I’ve had the chance to meet with volunteers to talk about what we’re each willing to do to stop the bad things happening in Texas and make the great things possible. It’s clear that it begins with registering eligible Democrats and then staying in touch with them all the way through the election. It’s encouraging to find so many who are so willing to do the necessary work, like becoming a Volunteer Deputy Registrar and spending the time meeting eligible voters where they are. Because that’s what it’s going to take for us to elect good people to power. We know it’s only a matter of time and effort – the more of us willing to put in the effort, the sooner we’ll get there. In San Antonio I met with some of our key volunteers who have been registering voters at San Antonio College. Beyond the number of young Texans that they’re adding to the roles, what impressed me was how this group of complete strangers are now friends, working together in common and creating a community organized around action and progress. That’s the spirit of Texas. I’m going to stay on the road for another week. Richmond, Houston, Fort Worth, Denton, Abilene, Lubbock and some in between. [ ]Your support of Powered by People ensures that we have the resources to grow our registration and organizing teams across the state of Texas. Please consider donating what you can to guarantee we can reach every eligible unregistered Democrat out there. [ ]DONATE $3 Thank you, Beto

Friend, it's Tania, Vicente's Campaign manager. I need to tell you straight:
We have good news and bad news.
BAD NEWS: in the last fundraising quarter, Vicente was **outraised** by his far-right MAGA opponent. Money isn't everything, but we can't afford to let far-right attacks lying about Vicente's record go unchallenged. That's why we have to catch up with fundraising this early on.
Let's be clear, this is a prime example of national Republicans trying to give cover for a candidate caught lying about basic facts and facing an FEC violation for improperly paying herself with campaign funds.
There's even a poll going around showing that Vicente could lose ❗ if we don't turn things around.
GOOD NEWS : no attack from the far-right could prevent Vicente from delivering for our communities. Just recently, he secured over $30M+ in federal funds for community initiatives, making sure TX Republicans like Greg Abbott and Ted Cruz don't leave South Texas Behind.
Friend, this is Texas' CLOSEST congressional district and a MUST-WIN for Democrats to take back Congress. Vicente's End of Month Fundraising Deadline is tonight, and we need to raise $7,226 more online to meet our End of Month Fundraising Goal. With gratitude,
Tania
Vicente's Campaign Manager
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

Friend, I am deeply proud to not just serve as an unapologetic Arab American Congresswoman but also to represent the largest Arab American community in our country, in Michigan’s 12th congressional district. This month, we hosted an Arab American Heritage Month reception to recognize the incredible contributions of Arab Americans across our country and share our commitment to continuing to uplift the stories and achievements of our Arab American neighbors. **This month, I want to support Arab Women United, a group in my district that’s empowering young women and advocating for human rights. Students in the group have been targeted on campus for holding teach-ins on violence against women, and now for speaking the truth about Gaza.** Arab Women United provides free resources such as financial literacy events, domestic violence advocacy, and mental health services for people in need. Growing up as a first-generation Arab-American immigrant, the group’s founder Zahraa wanted to foster a community of support for marginalized women. Now it’s a safe haven for women to express themselves and challenge the unjust status quo. clean_body: This month, I want to support Arab Women United, a group in my district that’s empowering young women and advocating for human rights. | | | Friend, I am deeply proud to not just serve as an unapologetic Arab American Congresswoman but also to represent the largest Arab American community in our country, in Michigan’s 12th congressional district. This month, we hosted an Arab American Heritage Month reception to recognize the incredible contributions of Arab Americans across our country and share our commitment to continuing to uplift the stories and achievements of our Arab American neighbors. This month, I want to support Arab Women United, a group in my district that’s empowering young women and advocating for human rights. Students in the group have been targeted on campus for holding teach-ins on violence against women, and now for speaking the truth about Gaza. Arab Women United provides free resources such as financial literacy events, domestic violence advocacy, and mental health services for people in need. Growing up as a first-generation Arab-American immigrant, the group’s founder Zahraa wanted to foster a community of support for marginalized women. Now it’s a safe haven for women to express themselves and challenge the unjust status quo. | Thank you for supporting this grassroots group, and for honoring Arab American Heritage Month with me. Friends-
Throughout session we asked people to share their stories, but what does that mean?
When we ask for stories, we’re asking people to share their experiences with the issues we focus on. Have you ever had an expensive healthcare bill you weren’t sure you’d be able to pay? Maybe an extra fee you didn’t know you’d need to budget for when making a purchase? Or having to go without pay and take time off from work to care for a loved one?
Your experiences with issues like access to affordable healthcare, access to paid leave, hidden fees, and more are valuable to the work we do at Freedom Virginia. Sharing your experience allows us to see what’s going on in communities in the Commonwealth and see who is affected by these big issues.
There are many ways you can share your experience! That may look like:

We are beginning a campaign this week to educate our supporters about our top priorities and ask them to share their experiences with these issues. We hope you’ll learn something from us and that we’ll have the privilege of learning more about our supporters!
Let’s get to work!

And the attempts by extreme, anti-democratic forces to rig the system in their favor – to effectively drown out people’s voices – will only get more brazen. But here’s why I’m optimistic: their path to power is determined by people like you. And if enough of us do our part to protect our democracy, they will fail.
