[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e6f042edca&e=e789b9d47e)
# Host Committee Happenings
A Newsletter by the Chicago 2024 Host Committee
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
## Note from the Host Committee
Welcome back to Host Committee Happenings!
We are only 110 days away from the most inclusive, accessible, and sustainable Democratic National Convention in history!
We’re working with the City of Chicago and local leaders to get our beautiful city ready to receive over 50,000 guests this summer. Keep reading to see what our team has been up to across Chicago!
Send us any ideas, questions or concerns about the upcoming DNC at [info@chicago2024.com](mailto:info@chicago2024.com).
|
---
## Promoting Local Business
| | | | | | | | | Last week, our Executive Director, Christy George, spoke at the Illinois Hispanic Chamber of Commerce [Breakfast Networking Meeting](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=c4c926dd9f&e=e789b9d47e), where she emphasized the Host Committee’s commitment to promoting and supporting our local businesses. She also discussed the team’s efforts to ensure that the convention workforce represents the diversity of our city and state. We're thrilled to showcase the best of Chicago and Illinois this summer.
---
|
---
|
---
## DNC Reception in Little Village
[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=094f788e79&e=e789b9d47e)
The convention team hosted a [reception](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=07c2ff8673&e=e789b9d47e) at Mi Tierra Restaurant in **Little Village** , a vibrant community in South Lawndale. The Association of State Democratic Committees and local leaders [joined](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=912d7d3942&e=e789b9d47e) us for an evening filled with delicious food, drinks, and a live Mariachi band. Our guests also had the chance to experience the neighborhood's rich culture and see its colorful murals, diverse street vendors, and lively Spanish music that adorn the busy streets. We were proud to showcase some of the neighborhood's best local vendors to our visitors and we encourage you to check them out as well.
**Indulge** in delicious churros from [El Churro Shop](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8590304c45&e=e789b9d47e).
**Shop** at [Artesanías Elena](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=635e289195&e=e789b9d47e) for beautiful handmade crafts by Mexican artisans.
**Enjoy** some chilaquiles at [La Cathedral Cafe](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=2bf3af2685&e=e789b9d47e) or authentic dishes at [Nuevo Leon Restaurant](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=271b48c5a6&e=e789b9d47e).
**Check out** [Ballet Folklorico Xochitl](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=494086a26d&e=e789b9d47e), which promotes Mexican culture and folkloric dance to children and youth.
|
---
## Community Engagement
| | | | | | | | |
#### Clean and Green
---
The Host Committee and the DNCC were happy to lend a hand at the City of Chicago’s annual Clean and Green event. We joined Mayor Brandon Johnson, 5th Ward Alderman Desmon Yancy, and 6th Ward Alderman William Hall at the Park Manor Mural in the **Greater Grand Crossing** community, to clean up the neighborhood and get our city ready for the DNC.
Thank you to all of the volunteers who came out to help our city shine!
|
---
#### Arbor Day
| | | | | | | | |
---
📸 _Patrick L. Pyszka_
|
---
We [joined](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0c55bdead5&e=e789b9d47e) staff from the Chicago Departments of Environment, Streets and Sanitation, Transportation, and the Bureau of Forestry ahead of Arbor Day to support the City of Chicago's tree planting efforts. Our team was grateful for the opportunity to mulch freshly planted trees on the **Near West Side**.
|
---
## Subcontracting Opportunities
The latest subcontracting opportunities from our partners are available here: [https://chicago2024.com/rfp/](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d2dbdb094f&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
## Event Management Team
We're excited about the five event production companies selected to plan the official parties for the Democratic National Convention. These teams have planned some of the most iconic events in Chicago and the Midwest and we're thrilled to have them on our team.
The five firms are Juan and Only, elemento L2, All Terrain Collective, Revel Global Events, and 5423 Productions.

[Read the Sun Time's story](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d905e73bd0&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
## Security Services RFP
The Host Committee and the DNCC released a new request for proposals (RFP) for security services for the convention. Vendors may submit bids to provide venue security services at the United Center and McCormick Place during convention week, as well as the option to provide security drivers.
| | | | | | | | | If you missed the Security Personnel Virtual Outreach Session, a replay is available [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f6caef445f&e=e789b9d47e).
---
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=4e621b0b39&e=e789b9d47e)
---
The scope of work encompasses routine security services for the Democratic National Convention, including perimeter control, access management at entry points, credential screening, and security drivers. The RFP can be found on the Host Committee’s website, [www.chicago2024.com](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0b2a64fa25&e=e789b9d47e).
**Final proposals must be submitted by Wednesday, May 8, 2024 at 5:00 PM Central Time.**
|
---
## DNC Vendor Directory and Venue Map
If you're planning to participate as a vendor, make sure to complete the Vendor Interest Form at [chicago2024.com/vendors](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8c676322bf&e=e789b9d47e) as soon as possible.
| | | | | | | | | [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=628b442b5a&e=e789b9d47e)
---
| By filling out the form, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your business to a wide audience and connect with potential customers. Our team will carefully review your submission and add your business to the [Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=83ca700c17&e=e789b9d47e) and [Venue Map](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=3997108641&e=e789b9d47e). Don't miss out - submit your form today!
---
Please note that inclusion in the vendor directory and venue map does not mean the Host Committee, Democratic National Convention Committee, or Democratic National Convention endorse or approve any of the listed vendors. The Directory is offered as a resource to groups and businesses who may need to procure services, facilities, or supplies for their events in Chicago in connection with the 2024 Democratic National Convention, and to encourage the use of local and diverse vendors for those needs.
For questions about vendors, please email [vendors@chicago2024.com](mailto:vendor@chicago2024.com). For questions about venues, please email [venues@chicago2024.com](mailto:venues@chicago2024.com).
|
---
## Volunteer Opportunities
Do you want to be a part of the biggest political event of the year? The Democratic National Convention is just around the corner, and you have the chance to be a part of it by volunteering! All you have to do to get started is complete our [Volunteer Interest Form](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=105b9806e7&e=e789b9d47e).
In case you missed any of our volunteer information sessions, you can always watch a replay [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=4e56cf1bb4&e=e789b9d47e).
| | | | | | | | | |
---
As we move forward, we'll be inviting individuals who completed the volunteer interest form to fill out a volunteer application. Once you complete the application and pass a screening and background check, you'll receive your assignments.
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=393c790dff&e=e789b9d47e)
---
If you have any additional questions about volunteering, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at [volunteers@chicago2024.com](mailto:volunteers@chicago2024.com).
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
## Sponsorship Opportunities
---
Is your business or organization looking for additional ways to get involved with the Democratic National Convention? Consider becoming a Convention sponsor or partner! Inquiries regarding sponsorships and partnerships should be sent to [development@chicago2024.com](mailto:development@chicago2024.com?subject=Sponsorships%20and%20Partnerships&body=null).
|
---
## 77 Spotlight
| | | | | | | | |
---
📸 [_Steve Geer_](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=30df23bd01&e=e789b9d47e)
|
---
|
---
This week, we are checking out **Hegewisch** , a small community located on the far south side of Chicago. Located along the rail line, this neighborhood is well-known for its manufacturing industry, particularly in the automobile sector, and is home to an operational Ford plant. You'll find plenty of bungalow-style homes scattered throughout Hegewisch, adding to its cozy, suburban vibe.
**Explore** the [Hegewisch Marsh](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e9aec3e642&e=e789b9d47e), 129 acres of beautiful wetlands and trails.
**Relax** at the [William W. Powers State Recreation Area](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=19a7c93c7b&e=e789b9d47e), an Illinois state park.
**Play** ball or go for a swim at [Mann Park](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ad7e994ad5&e=e789b9d47e).
**Eat** fresh seafood at [Club 81 Too](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=00f03f4b51&e=e789b9d47e) or grab a drink at [Steve’s Lounge](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d0e691fba9&e=e789b9d47e).
|
---
## Vendor Spotlights
Check out the latest spotlights from our vendor directory:
| | | | | | | | |
---
[Ruth Davis Beauty](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=5d840237c6&e=e789b9d47e) is an incredibly talented makeup [artist](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ffa5f48a6f&e=e789b9d47e) who specializes in creating stunning looks for professional headshots, bridal events, clean makeup, and editorials. Our senior staffers were happy with her work!
|
---
[Beyond Baskets](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=6d57868868&e=e789b9d47e) have been creating quality gift baskets perfect for any occasion since 1991. They create each basket with love and pay close attention to every detail to ensure it's tailored to clients’ preferences!
_If you’d like to be featured in our newsletter or social media channels, please sign up for our vendor directory and email us with your business name, logo, description, and a picture or video that best describes your business._
|
---
## Staff Spotlight
This week, we're shining a light on our Senior Advisor, **Keiana A. Barrett**.
| | | | | | | | | Keiana is a native of the south side of Chicago and currently lives in the beautiful **South Shore** neighborhood.
When it comes to food, Keiana says her favorite restaurant is Bronzeville Winery. When she's not working hard connecting vendors to opportunities, she loves spending time with her loved ones, practicing hot yoga, writing, and crafting delicious cocktails.
---
| |
---
Keiana’s favorite thing to do in Chicago is to attend Summer Cultural Festivals. Trust us, you won't want to miss out on these incredible [events](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=6ee2d6374c&e=e789b9d47e)!
|
---
| | | | | | | | |

Tonight’s an important end-of-month grassroots fundraising deadline for our re-election campaign, so let me be direct with you: [**I’m about to ask if you can pitch in a donation of $3 or any amount.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2179?amount=3&t=8&akid=2156%2E4032634%2EGYtCc5) We’ve got to hit all our fundraising goals this year, including April’s — and we just got another reminder of why that’s the case. **A new right-wing Super PAC just launched to target me and boost one of my GOP opponents. And we can’t take it lightly.** [**Will you chip in any amount before midnight to help make sure we can fight back and win re-election this year?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2179?t=9&akid=2156%2E4032634%2EGYtCc5)

---
Officer Chris Taylor stands on the brink of losing
everything—his freedom, his family, his future—all for
doing the job he swore an oath to do: protect and
serve.
Chris faces a trial that could unjustly imprison him for
life.
The charge? Acting in defense of himself and others
against an imminent, life-threatening danger.
Yet, despite his actions being in line with his duty, he's
been ensnared by a legal system that seems more
interested in making examples out of our officers than
in serving justice.
The heart of this ordeal is a confrontation that turned
perilous instantly—a scenario officers dread but are prepared for. Chris did what he was trained to do.
But now, an indictment looms over him, propelled by a District Attorney whose campaign was bankrolled by George Soros.

**This isn't just an attack on Chris; it's an assault on the very principles of law and order.**
**[Your contribution of $25, $50, or even $100 or more will support Chris’s legal defense and ensure justice is served.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jrFugzAYhJ_GbEb22cYweGgb0aljInWqjP0TrEBA4Kjl7Suiquvdp7vPT8uY-t0x-8qAIcWNAUy9MOCR1cWfzx_rzj9vDX83F1yPEm8MyPtC_-TfSEmTT-OR2lMRnYaXfSjISSu1kdCyKgYXdB2UVE3TyaaSJlqvSNRSVToK6RWK5CCghVYCEpVuytqiJxhhKxhBtWFaPI_KfiXKQ7rfaI0-jXsZ5qkY3ZDzsj3FWoZ2o_BYqfR3inM-CIb2HpbI0MaOZ0ROEzeW009mqt3mxxroK8yRmDrFjh8op8nYjguBYnVx-U7jmLbKMi2uT48wT78BAAD__5WuYQU)**
The toll this ordeal has taken on Chris's family is unimaginable.
Amy, his wife, and their son now face a future shrouded in uncertainty, potentially without Chris by their side.
It's a scenario no family should ever have to contemplate, much less endure.
Our system, designed to protect the guardians of our safety, is failing.
That's why I'm stepping forward, not just as a sheriff but as a citizen deeply concerned about the precedent Chris's case could set.
I'm asking you to stand with me, to make a stand for justice, for fairness, for the men and women who put their lives on the line every day.
Your support for Chris's legal defense is not just a donation; it's a declaration that we will not stand idly by while our heroes are targeted.
We will not let Chris's dedication and sacrifice be in vain. Together, we can help ensure that justice prevails.
**[Join me in this fight. Stand with us, stand with Chris. Your contribution today could make all the difference tomorrow.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jrFugzAYhJ_GbEb22cYweGgb0aljInWqjP0TrEBA4Kjl7Suiquvdp7vPT8uY-t0x-8qAIcWNAUy9MOCR1cWfzx_rzj9vDX83F1yPEm8MyPtC_-TfSEmTT-OR2lMRnYaXfSjISSu1kdCyKgYXdB2UVE3TyaaSJlqvSNRSVToK6RWK5CCghVYCEpVuytqiJxhhKxhBtWFaPI_KfiXKQ7rfaI0-jXsZ5qkY3ZDzsj3FWoZ2o_BYqfR3inM-CIb2HpbI0MaOZ0ROEzeW009mqt3mxxroK8yRmDrFjh8op8nYjguBYnVx-U7jmLbKMi2uT48wT78BAAD__5WuYQU)**
Together, let's right this wrong.
Sincerely,
Sheriff David Clarke

Too many adults drowning under mountains of home, student, or medical debt as their wages were slashed, companies were shuttered, and vital tax dollars were spent on missiles and fighter jets instead of supporting families in need. If you spend five minutes listening to your average American, and the struggles they’re facing, you’ll hear the same story. Again and again and again and again. And yet, all they were met with was inaction. Indecision. A bunch of stubborn lawmakers who’d rather bury their heads in the sand than admit that maybe, the policies they’ve been pushing for the last ten, twenty, thirty years were making things _worse_ for the people, not better. **So I decided to run for office myself. And in 2022, Summer Lee, Delia Ramirez, and Greg Casar won massive elections as well. Together, we have built a strong and formidable group in Congress — one that fights for the many, not the few. ---
| Ever wonder how Mike Madrid can predict the shifting dynamics of the Latino voting block years in advance? Despite the rumors, he does not interpret patterns in cloud formations. The man of many talents, Mike Madrid, reveals it all in his very own book - The Latino Century, How America’s Largest Minority Is Transforming Democracy.
---
| [ ](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=0d203a783c&e=5bd167f239)

Mike Madrid recalls his thirty years of research and campaign experience with both parties to address what each party must do to prepare for the incoming Latino wave. The Latino Century explores the true meaning of America at a time of rapid cultural change, the founding principles of self-government and individual responsibility, and one man’s journey through a political party that has turned itself inside out.

Do not be swayed by the hatred, threats and violence being directed toward you and your movement.
At no point in American history have our esteemed institutions acted thoughtfully or wisely when confronted by the leaders of the next generation. Especially when the stakes are as high as they are today.
Your actions are perceived as threats by not only the universities and the government, but also to the religious fanatics who are holding these institutions hostage by way of threatening their most necessary resource: money.
That's true of both your colleges and your congressmen.
Zealots can become inflexible when they hold the power. They rule by silencing dissent and obfuscating the truth. We saw it in Vietnam, the invasions of Afghanistan and Iraq, and now the United States' complicity in genocide in Gaza.
You have truth and morality on your side, and what is happening today in Gaza will go down as one of the most horrific international conflicts of the 21st century.
Your best asset is that they underestimate your strength and resolve. You are protesting the worst crimes against humanity, and risking your education, safety and freedom in doing it.
Meanwhile, the media goes along with the gaslighting by members of those who are radical or radical-adjacent, playing up fears based on an alternate reality where those who support the genocide overseas are somehow victims of antiwar protests.
This is best captured in two videos circulating online:
One shows a white woman, in full BBQ-Becky fashion, calling the police on people who are not even speaking to her, falsely claiming they're surrounding her and threatening her. The other is a self-published video of a white woman with "Jew" written on her sweater walking through a protest pissed off as everyone ignores her, because she was looking for a fight.
Perhaps this is the fault of people like Josh Hawley and Jared Moskowitz- lying about exaggerated and even non- existent threats to Jewish people on campus, making these young people believe in an anti-Jew boogeyman hiding behind every keffiyeh.
They either cannot or will not concede that one can stand against genocide without standing against Jewish people, and they shout traitor to the many Jews standing up to the propagators of this harmful propaganda. They don't care who they hurt - they'll draft as many performative statements and host as many press conferences as they want to squeeze all of the money out of the very people that they are trying to scare.
These are the same rich, white politicians who foam at the mouth just thinking about inflicting further harm and physical violence against the largely non-white groups demanding justice for Gazans. They are cheering for police brutality, when so many were elected on promises or commitments to stop police violence.
The parallels between the violence by police directed toward antiwar protesters today and those who protested the injustices of the Vietnam War are breathtaking.
While seeing the echoes of Republican attacks coming from Democrats, sounding not at all dissimilar to the same way the GOP demonized Black Lives Matter protests, might be discouraging, know that there are many more of us who are on your side. Some may not be ready to speak out, and we might think of them as cowards for that, but I've learned that you cannot force someone to be brave if it's not in their nature. You are the unique few that speaks for those too afraid to.
Though you might be afraid of what's next, know that courage doesn't come from a lack of fear-- courage cannot exist without the knowledge of the challenge and risk ahead. Courage means knowing the risk, fearing the danger, and doing what's right anyway.
And even if you are arrested, your life is not over.
Quite a few of our leaders have a mugshot or two in their past. Some were earned [fighting to protect people](https://substack.com/redirect/72ffc329-17a0-4c27-98e1-74ad69700023?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while others have been... well, [less than noble ](https://substack.com/redirect/c022fa14-5fb8-4cc5-9fdf-3398cfb5abff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)crimes.
My mugshot from my 2021 arrest - about a month after [my home was raided without a warrant on orders of the Florida governor](https://substack.com/redirect/c2858489-c57b-43a0-ae9f-d18388229d81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)\- hangs on my wall, framed, next to a note sent to me by the late Vietnam whistleblower and my good friend Daniel Ellsberg.
Ellsberg nearly had his life destroyed by a president who wanted to bury the truth. He faced treason charges for pulling the veil back on the failures of the Vietnam War.
His only regret, he told me, is that he didn't come forward sooner.
Plus, my favorite professors were the ones who shared their arrest stories from the protests they went to about climate change, indigenous rights or nuclear proliferation.
And one day you'll be damn proud of what you're doing today.
While we want to believe academia is a safe haven for free speech, that notion often ends at the lecture hall doors.
It's up to you to change the universities and the national conversation about this country's role in the mass, indiscriminate killing of innocent people with our bombs, our money.
It shouldn't have to be on your shoulders -- the weight of righting systemic wrongs -- but it is.
Somehow, it always is.

Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my time in Congress serving North Carolina’s 8th District. Or you may be coming across me for the first time. Either way, I’m glad to be reaching out to you, and I think this could be the beginning of a great relationship. My name is Dan Bishop, and I’m running for Attorney General for North Carolina with the intention of bringing Law and Order back to the Tar Heel State.

**[This email is a bit longer and I hope you’ll read through it. I’m going to ask you for a donation to my campaign at the end of this email, but let me explain why it’s so crucial you join my team first.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=925915f87e114d1383f9f7bb83bd41f2&_e=AgfVjdzIm1rAd5yDerrDopHLlbQ55TKZoWN_pWxoXgeZ8QusALpTXNdFozHydzHVToXLbP-eCiBWltOrtxo-rJd4WyWrr49RmC67v4NnXHKqNEBjS0Ne7Fps5JU_2nGYDMwDTkXG378HHZcB0pMXx5-ZuYST6HnJDk30eny5F4X311uD9ZfWtpPS90GRjQY5NEMrc241DZcWDQg8fg4jlsVjF0E8WkJmcKOXUuopDxoWYHSmbL85LCBE31OeRgj1CxQLKaWrtzhnXJFrMUmKD5Dl6-Zb3G4WWBm_zpFpPtLMDoO70KpoBVOJFbTItDBNRwDarAlSe7rIxzbrcSaJKaWrXdfN_zhLaEPt54rMuWEcKyotkm6q98oo3b8Sps59Ch50URDCrg-rFUCU4eqokg%3D%3D)**

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=925915f87e114d1383f9f7bb83bd41f2&_e=AgfVjdzIm1rAd5yDerrDopHLlbQ55TKZoWN_pWxoXgeZ8QusALpTXNdFozHydzHVToXLbP-eCiBWltOrtxo-rJd4WyWrr49RmC67v4NnXHKqNEBjS0Ne7Fps5JU_2nGYDMwDTkXG378HHZcB0pMXx5-ZuYST6HnJDk30eny5F4X311uD9ZfWtpPS90GRjQY5NEMrc241DZcWDQg8fg4jlsVjF0E8WkJmcKOXUuopDxoWYHSmbL85LCBE31OeRgj1qOWPyoBY30Pn9H_a-F4YcE0yd7YIRpe4oS5T6IJck_-7NiMFX_p9UVxnzn55aEcB-rKZclu5e5e_6Q2Z269mSxed3MBTMN34TfK6LPcdZuAlGAvZquR9ox8HzSOYKncwxrtDvkJGSvNyqoJ5OxXe9A%3D%3D)
I was born and raised with my four siblings in North Carolina by my parents, Kaytee and Bud. They didn’t come from much, but they pushed me towards an education and instilled a hard work ethic. With a passion for law and justice, I earned my JD at UNC Chappel Hill. I then went on to marry my wife of 25 years (and going), Jo; we raised our son, Jack, who’s currently following in his dad’s footsteps as he’s working to attain his law degree.

As a lawyer, I’m very proud of my track record. I was a commercial litigator for nearly three decades, where I was voted 10 times to Business NC’s “Legal Elite” and was selected 7 times by “Super Lawyers.” I was tenacious as a litigator and handled complex cases. But, I finally felt that it was time to help a broader scope of North Carolinians and decided to run for Congress.

In Congress, I’ve been one of the toughest and most outspoken conservatives, challenging the radical left and holding my fellow Republicans accountable. As a member of the judiciary committee and the subcommittee on the weaponization of the federal government, I fought the Biden administration’s dangerous policies and exposed the federal government’s abuses against the Trump presidency.

Now, I’m running for Attorney General to defend the rule of law and protect North Carolina. I believe Democrats like Roy Cooper and Josh Stein have abused the state’s top law enforcement office by turning it into a stepping stone for higher office and a platform to spread liberal propaganda. I’m putting my foot down, demanding respect for the office of Attorney General, and bringing Law and Order back to our great state.

**All that to say, I have a track record of fighting the good fight. And I hope you’ll join my team. The good fight is not free; running a campaign gets expensive, having to reach voters across the state, taking care of campaign staffers with food and gas, and running ads on TV.** **[That’s why I’m humbly asking you for a donation of whatever you can afford.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=925915f87e114d1383f9f7bb83bd41f2&_e=AgfVjdzIm1rAd5yDerrDopHLlbQ55TKZoWN_pWxoXgeZ8QusALpTXNdFozHydzHVToXLbP-eCiBWltOrtxo-rJd4WyWrr49RmC67v4NnXHKqNEBjS0Ne7Fps5JU_2nGYDMwDTkXG378HHZcB0pMXx5-ZuYST6HnJDk30eny5F4X311uD9ZfWtpPS90GRjQY5NEMrc241DZcWDQg8fg4jlsVjF0E8WkJmcKOXUuopDxoWYHSmbL85LCBE31OeRgj1m0xRQKUZktzpbcrb47rk-yQBCV4UI4Zl3JHEyaxNgPzvHAJIQYJiGlNtCBGbv_fdWapXoEr07UlhNSixiheK5dY-v4yZMTKJopDbIvVa-gJf6pH6E0EndZBH3ovX2tczL5dnH4jvlqx4crigElY8_Q%3D%3D)**

If you’ve gotten this far, I want to personally thank you for reading this email. Maybe it means you’ve been a supporter for quite some time. Or maybe it means you’re intrigued by my story and also believe in Law and Order over Chaos and Disorder. **[Either way, can you send my campaign just $1 or more to help me out?](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=925915f87e114d1383f9f7bb83bd41f2&_e=AgfVjdzIm1rAd5yDerrDopHLlbQ55TKZoWN_pWxoXgeZ8QusALpTXNdFozHydzHVToXLbP-eCiBWltOrtxo-rJd4WyWrr49RmC67v4NnXHKqNEBjS0Ne7Fps5JU_2nGYDMwDTkXG378HHZcB0pMXx5-ZuYST6HnJDk30eny5F4X311uD9ZfWtpPS90GRjQY5NEMrc241DZcWDQg8fg4jlsVjF0E8WkJmcKOXUuopDxoWYHSmbL85LCBE31OeRgj1mAkLUMfWeikYf3EZquPVyCS90xL_eyZbnP6mfNxkdsgcL6aHSwATuAD60Yyx-oghm8hdENMD7zDHDJEHzdpyiQDQyFxaeVXbvxdhLuLpG8f0T2L_G92HU7fI6KnUfUG7oyLIUswfd6kMucvOoWBDsw%3D%3D)**

Thank you,

clean_body: In case you don’t know this about me already | Fellow American, You may already know who I am from my time in Congress serving North Carolina’s 8th District. Or you may be coming across me for the first time. Either way, I’m glad to be reaching out to you, and I think this could be the beginning of a great relationship. My name is Dan Bishop, and I’m running for Attorney General for North Carolina with the intention of bringing Law and Order back to the Tar Heel State. I was born and raised with my four siblings in North Carolina by my parents, Kaytee and Bud. They didn’t come from much, but they pushed me towards an education and instilled a hard work ethic. With a passion for law and justice, I earned my JD at UNC Chappel Hill. I then went on to marry my wife of 25 years (and going), Jo; we raised our son, Jack, who’s currently following in his dad’s footsteps as he’s working to attain his law degree. As a lawyer, I’m very proud of my track record. I was a commercial litigator for nearly three decades, where I was voted 10 times to Business NC’s “Legal Elite” and was selected 7 times by “Super Lawyers.” I was tenacious as a litigator and handled complex cases. But, I finally felt that it was time to help a broader scope of North Carolinians and decided to run for Congress. In Congress, I’ve been one of the toughest and most outspoken conservatives, challenging the radical left and holding my fellow Republicans accountable. As a member of the judiciary committee and the subcommittee on the weaponization of the federal government, I fought the Biden administration’s dangerous policies and exposed the federal government’s abuses against the Trump presidency. Now, I’m running for Attorney General to defend the rule of law and protect North Carolina. I believe Democrats like Roy Cooper and Josh Stein have abused the state’s top law enforcement office by turning it into a stepping stone for higher office and a platform to spread liberal propaganda. I’m putting my foot down, demanding respect for the office of Attorney General, and bringing Law and Order back to our great state. All that to say, I have a track record of fighting the good fight. And I hope you’ll join my team. The good fight is not free; running a campaign gets expensive, having to reach voters across the state, taking care of campaign staffers with food and gas, and running ads on TV. If you’ve gotten this far, I want to personally thank you for reading this email. Maybe it means you’ve been a supporter for quite some time. Or maybe it means you’re intrigued by my story and also believe in Law and Order over Chaos and Disorder. Thank you, Dan Bishop | Paid for by Bishop for NC PO Box 1285 Waxhaw, NC 28173

body:
Don’t open this if you can’t keep a secret |
---
Fellow American,

**I’m glad that you opened this email, but this needs to be kept a secret between us.**

**I’m behind my next major fundraising goal and the deadline is TONIGHT, even though President Trump just endorsed me. This is not good. How did we get to this point?**

**FIRST:** I launched my campaign to flip PA-08 red and fire Matt Cartwright, who is backed by Joe Biden. Nancy Pelosi and the Radical Left Woke Money Machine. I want to empower my community and stand up for the little guy, and that means standing up to career politicians like Matt Cartwright, who has lied countless times to Americans and sided with Nancy Pelosi 100 percent of the time in Congress. Cartwright snuck by with victories in 2016 and 2020 despite President Trump winning in PA-08 both times.

**THEN:** President Trump endorsed me, noting the difference between my opponent and me, “Rob worked hard to Create Jobs and Grow the Economy, unlike his opponent, Matt Cartwright, who is completely beholden to Nancy Pelosi and the Radical Left.” Speaker Johnson, Steve Scalise, Elise Stefanik, Tom Emmer, and countless others also endorsed me.

**NOW:** [**I’m asking you to endorse me and to chip in a donation of whatever you can afford.**](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=cab3db17c6aa4e8aa0f065286f55a895&_e=r7P6A5sv3xWCZ8ranrXpesWeY8c4jv6F_MDZlQ0TYs7vLvHmnpbgXn562Pr9-QkhW9voV_UZYOjZNemDeu9tTjhxaZRNSllEaqTtJgMwWYFLoXuW6FDrEnsgingXYWIlYeNEA8JADIoGzpK-N77RBVvBy1-vIw4gCkZo9MHafCohuLD3WAmZ6otCM1Xyv67fcSNXozCVBcSg-0O7ukikI58z8-PFOBdF1ztZEk0cKbALED1XTR6cIJEEY2Nb-9Rd9P9bFrwKn13TF6_JhHVDDq6IIO0wyzDAE8UCb8ElhoG1g4umN7yBHw9h6zuds2JHOG-eZcM2e009lJrEjNMNzAFuJvpW0e5DYxqZuSFfLQJm4B4IHLrKdo_27k4-a1rFelRK78ahwS0gFLvuukVezgRZriw_p-L8hCKKCkn3rcw%3D) It may not seem like much, but having a strong flow of grassroots donors and supporters will help me finally unseat Cartwright, expand our House Majority, and give President Trump one more much-needed ally in Congress when we win on November 5. This is only achievable if we meet our fundraising goals, and it starts with my next major deadline. Help me catch up.

# Launching Imagine Better Media!!!

Today, I am proud to announce the launch of Imagine Better Media. In a time where modern media focuses on buzzwords and clickbait, we are building something better.
Imagine Better Media is a platform covering each story's history, problems, and solutions. We will cover the stories you care about, so let us know.
We will release three stories each week: a federal story, a state story, and a local story. These stories will come in three formats to follow in your preferred method. We will have videos, podcasts, and articles for each.
